| | The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress,**** friend: Minnesota joined the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact and**Maine's state legislature is working to join as well.** If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. **17** **states plus DC have now joined.** Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now **accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election** and totaling 78% of what is needed to make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress. Whether it's through the NPVIC or one of the other legal alternatives, ending the Electoral College forever is a big priority.**[We are going to make this happen! Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and totaling 78% of what is needed to make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress. Whether it's through the NPVIC or one of the other legal alternatives, ending the Electoral College forever is a big priority. If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Defenders of voting rights like Cory Booker, AOC, Robert Reich, and Stacey Abrams recognize that the Electoral College is harming our democracy and needs to go. State legislatures in Nevada, Michigan, and more are heeding the call and also considering bills to join the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact. The Electoral College is the biggest tool that opponents of voting rights have to swing national elections and suppress the will of the people. We have to take away this dangerous mechanism that enabled the January 6th insurrection by any means necessary. you for your commitment, Voter Action Project's Electoral College Team | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Good riddance.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I'm not letting him off the hook.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2559%2E4032634%2EwL9vYx)
---
Good riddance, Elon Musk. This week the richest man in the world’s status as a Special Government Employee came to an end. But let’s be clear: he isn't off the hook for his chaos and corruption. We must hold him accountable. Elon Musk’s brief but destructive rampage through our federal government has caused — and will continue to cause — real pain and chaos for millions of Americans. Despite his department’s silly name, he made our government much less efficient — like by firing hundreds of thousands of federal workers and dedicated civil servants and making others send weekly emails to him about what they’re up to. Or cutting Social Security resources and creating longer wait times, backlogged cases, and months of longer waiting times for benefits. Or cruelly halting humanitarian aid efforts in real-time — costing lives. Estimates have shown that his mass firings will actually cost the US government upwards of $135 billion this fiscal year because of all the rehirings, paid administrative leave, and lost productivity. While he was operating under the veil of “rooting out waste” in our government, he was cutting funding for cancer research, veterans programs, and aid for American farmers, all while making $8 million a day from government contracts. And while he said he was “eliminating fraud” he and his band of 22-year-old programmers were gaining access to the private financial information of millions of Americans. **Again, we’re not letting him off the hook. That’s why I’m calling for an investigation into conflicts of interest at DOGE. I’m pressing for the Justice Department to look into whether DOGE minions potentially violated criminal conflicts of interest or violated federal ethics rules at the Treasury Department, the CFPB, and the IRS.** DOGE is still operating under leaders with clear conflicts of interest: Like holding stock in companies that are subject to investigation by the CFPB, or owning shares of Intuit, the parent company of TurboTax, while also working to end the IRS’ free Direct File program. The American people deserve accountability. Neither Elon Musk or those working on his behalf in DOGE are above the law, and I’m going to stay on it. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

#### This Memorial Day, while we honor the service and sacrifice of those who gave everything for our freedoms, we also reflect on what those freedoms are meant to protect—**honest government, fair opportunity, and a voice for the people**.
#### But in Juneau, the people are being forgotten.
#### The Legislature just closed its latest session—not with discipline, not with restraint, but with a **stampede of giveaways**. Millions of dollars in taxpayer funds handed over to the **National Education Association** and entrenched union bureaucracies—while schools close their doors, and more Alaskan families than ever turn to charter schools and homeschooling.
#### What was the dividend meant to do?
The **Permanent Fund Dividend** was designed as a promise—that all Alaskans would share in the wealth of our natural resources. It was never meant to become a **slush fund for lobbyists, consultants, and political machines controlled by out-of-state interests.**
#### This is not just bad budgeting.
It’s a betrayal of the people—and the purpose—of Alaska.
#### Our upcoming film, _The Permanent Short: Alaska’s Billion Dollar Betrayal_ , will expose this corruption. We’ll follow the money and show how generations of Alaskans are being denied their share, their voice, and their future.
#### And the movement is already growing.
#### Our **Angel tickets were the first to sell out for “Frozen Odds”** —a powerful signal that Alaskans are ready to fight back. Angel supporters receive exclusive access to both _The Permanent Short_ and _Frozen Odds_ , the film that lit the fuse.
#### This is just the beginning.
#### The fight for Alaska’s future isn’t over.
It’s just getting started.

#### **In 2001, Enron collapsed under the weight of one of the largest corporate frauds in American history—over $25 billion evaporated overnight, leaving pensions gutted and lives destroyed. It was called the smartest disaster money could buy.**
#### But what if the next Enron wasn’t a corporation?
What if it was your own government?
#### This film asks the billion-dollar question:
**What happens when a state quietly reallocates tens of billions of dollars meant for its citizens—without a vote, without consent, and without accountability?**
#### We follow the money—through shadowy nonprofits, bloated bureaucracies, and politically connected networks like **Arabella Advisors** , **Alaska Venture Fund** , and the **1630 Fund**.
#### It’s a financial betrayal not buried in spreadsheets—but broadcast in silence.
**$25 billion gone** —not from shareholders this time, but from the people of Alaska.
#### This is _The Permanent Short_.
#### More announcements coming soon.
**Thank you for being part of this journey.**

#### **Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process.**
#### **Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**

Key Features: Election data and turnout insights Breakdown of vote-splitting and outcomes Mobile-friendly analysis of RCV impacts Access from any phone or computer Understand what really happened—and why it matters. | This Memorial Day, while we honor the service and sacrifice of those who gave everything for our freedoms, we also reflect on what those freedoms are meant to protect—honest government, fair opportunity, and a voice for the people. But in Juneau, the people are being forgotten. The Legislature just closed its latest session—not with discipline, not with restraint, but with a stampede of giveaways. Millions of dollars in taxpayer funds handed over to the National Education Association and entrenched union bureaucracies—while schools close their doors, and more Alaskan families than ever turn to charter schools and homeschooling. What was the dividend meant to do? The Permanent Fund Dividend was designed as a promise—that all Alaskans would share in the wealth of our natural resources. It was never meant to become a slush fund for lobbyists, consultants, and political machines controlled by out-of-state interests. This is not just bad budgeting. It’s a betrayal of the people—and the purpose—of Alaska. Our upcoming film, The Permanent Short: Alaska’s Billion Dollar Betrayal , will expose this corruption. We’ll follow the money and show how generations of Alaskans are being denied their share, their voice, and their future. And the movement is already growing. Our Angel tickets were the first to sell out for “Frozen Odds” —a powerful signal that Alaskans are ready to fight back. Angel supporters receive exclusive access to both The Permanent Short and Frozen Odds , the film that lit the fuse. This is just the beginning. The fight for Alaska’s future isn’t over. It’s just getting started. In 2001, Enron collapsed under the weight of one of the largest corporate frauds in American history—over $25 billion evaporated overnight, leaving pensions gutted and lives destroyed. It was called the smartest disaster money could buy. But what if the next Enron wasn’t a corporation? What if it was your own government? This film asks the billion-dollar question: What happens when a state quietly reallocates tens of billions of dollars meant for its citizens—without a vote, without consent, and without accountability? We follow the money—through shadowy nonprofits, bloated bureaucracies, and politically connected networks like Arabella Advisors , Alaska Venture Fund , and the 1630 Fund. It’s a financial betrayal not buried in spreadsheets—but broadcast in silence. $25 billion gone —not from shareholders this time, but from the people of Alaska. This is The Permanent Short. More announcements coming soon. Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process. body:
Biden DEI Agenda for West Point Exposed

[INSIDE JW]

DOCUMENTS DETAIL WEST POINT COVER-UP OF REMOVAL OF ‘DUTY, HONOR,
COUNTRY’ FROM MISSION STATEMENT

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35317&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1uR0N2alZpQ0Y5NCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=87d76fe9211357d6a92b6631997a199da1f51cbcbca9938d2932d51361490b27]

Last year the U.S. Military Academy at West Point under President
Biden removed the words “Duty, Honor and Country” from its mission
statement, and in doing so it demonstrated a total lack of honor.

Judicial Watch received 445 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35306&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLXdlc3QtcG9pbnQtbWlzc2lvbi1yZWNvcmRzLTAxNzU3L11vZj91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=c5591fb6409d91ab344019417aae37cff728cf72695e8686706b7431795bc3f2
records from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point revealing that
speakers at the March 2024 “Founders Day
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35307&F=T&&hash=ffa2f538d8cc80787fe134447565d7e8a0382a11567ca76d1e424ea156b646a8
event were instructed to “AVOID saying ‘removed,’
‘replaced,’ ‘deleted’ [when referring to the new mission
statement] – just refer to the ‘updated mission statement and
reinforce that the motto remains unchanged.” [Emphasis in original]
The records also tie DEI (Diversity, Equity and Inclusion) efforts to
the mission statement controversy.

These records detail how the DEI agenda helped change the mission
statement of West Point – and how leadership under the Biden
administration tried to cover it up.

In a March 12, 2024, “Message from the 61st Superintendent
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=32774&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2VzdHBvaW50LmVkdS9uZXdzL2NvbW11bml0eS1uZXdzL21lc3NhZ2UtdGhlLTYxc3Qtc3VwZXJpbnRlbmRlbnRdLOKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=06e14a93bff981baa0ab1ce1f2ae2662a861b265cd56fc5cfe4815ffdfcfc48b
Superintendent LTG Steven Gilland announced the change, referencing
the Army’s continued commitment to “Duty, Honor and Country” and
then announced the new mission statement without explaining why the
words themselves were deleted.

The records were produced in our June 2024 Freedom of Information Act
(FOIA) lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=32830&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvd2VzdC1wb2ludC1taXNzaW9uLXN0YXRlbWVudC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=004873e5747d44b61bec7204a555a7b30c8fed67203cbc3e99b828851c238135]
filed
when West Point failed to respond to a March 2024 FOIA request
(_Judicial Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of Defense_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=32772&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLXdlc3QtcG9pbnQtY29tcGxhaW50LTAxNzU3Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=ee50a7f210f5e7782b1d83d283e1671588bffb1cd42ef872303025a31656d731]
(No. 1:24-cv-01757)). Judicial Watch is asking for:

* All documents which form the basis upon which the decision was made
to remove the phrase “Duty, Honor, Country” from the United States
Military Academy Mission Statement, according to various reports (such
as
https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=32773&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9hcm1lZGZvcmNlcy5wcmVzcy9yZXBvcnQtd2VzdC1wb2ludC10by1yZW1vdmUtZHV0eS1ob25vci1jb3VudHJ5LWZyb20tb2ZmaWNpYWwtbWlzc2lvbi1zdGF0ZW1lbnQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=c83dd8a81ce68ad46b5ab8ebce6c70589930e46f5955219108a8d55d6a6750b7).
* All emails between the following USMA officials and other email
accounts ending in .mil or .gov regarding the removal of “Duty,
Honor, Country” from the USMA Mission Statement: Superintendent LTG
Steve Gilland, MG Lori Robinson, and BG Shane Reeves.

The records include a March 23, 2024, email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35308&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLXdlc3QtcG9pbnQtbWlzc2lvbi1yZWNvcmRzLTAxNzU3LXBncy00LTE3Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=fad94cf6691c88421cbadd3687afa8c467d7eab56993c3e2ea171487e8623f18]
from Gilland to LTG Christopher Donahue regarding “Founders Day
Speaker Talking Points and FAQs” with four attachments, one of which
states:

Our motto is who we are. Our mission statement is what we do.

* Duty, Honor, Country is carved in granite across West Point, adorns
our cadets’ uniforms, and will always remain our motto.
* The mission statement codifies our mission essential tasks: build,
educate, train and inspire the Corps of Cadets to be commissioned
leaders of character.
* The revised mission statement was approved by—but not directed
by—the Secretary of the Army and the Chief of Staff.
* _AVOID__ saying “removed,” “replaced,” “deleted”—
just refer to the “updated mission statement and reinforce that the
motto remains unchanged.”_ [Emphasis in original]

In the “FAQ” attachment is an explanation regarding “DEI in
Curriculum:”

* USMA [U.S. Military Academy] does not have a core curriculum
dedicated to Critical Race Theory (CRT). CRT is explicitly covered in
one upper-level elective - The Politics of Race, Gender, and
Sexuality. Out of 30 lessons, there is one lesson introducing CRT and
another focusing on critiques of CRT.
* USMA has a Diversity and Inclusion Studies Minor (DISM); created in
2017. Five to eight students each year complete the minor.

The “FAQ” attachment’s “Diversity Conference” section
details:

* USMS’s Diversity and Inclusion Leadership Conference, as with all
USMA conferences, encourages participants to present alternative
viewpoints and challenge assumptions. This aligns with our mission to
develop leaders of character who are mentally agile, perspective-laden
critical thinkers.

* In other words, our goal is to teach Cadets HOW to think, not WHAT
to think. [Emphasis in original]

An additional bullet in the document under the heading “NDAA”
(National Defense Authorization Act) reads:

* We are working in coordination with HQDA [Headquarters, Department
of the Army] to comply with DEI-related provisions of the FY2024
National Defense Authorization Act that relate to USMA.

A November 2023 “Memorandum for Superintendent
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35309&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLXdlc3QtcG9pbnQtbWlzc2lvbi1yZWNvcmRzLTAxNzU3LXBncy0xNzEtMTcyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=507b013f8a9ae327a992f4b0fe6d0e06ef29a6ceba178747cc29489a39ce29b7],
USMA [U.S. Military Academy]” is intended for Gilland and addresses
a “requested change for USMA [U.S. Military Academy] Mission” from
its current reading to a revised form that is fully redacted:

> Current:
>
> To educate, train, and inspire the Corps of Cadets so that each
> graduate is a 4 [sic] leader of character committed to the values of
> Duty, Honor, Country and prepared for a career of professional
> excellence and service to the Nation as an officer in the United
> States Army.
>
> Revised:

> [Redacted]

Under the heading “Rationale for USMA [U.S. Military Academy]”
Mission key edits” the memorandum instructs:

> Substitute “Army Values” for “Duty, Honor Country.” We
> expect leaders of character to demonstrate all seven Army values.
> This change strengthens our connection to the Army. We will retain
> Duty, Honor, Country as the USMA [U.S. Military Academy] Motto.

In a March 11, 2024, email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35310&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLXdlc3QtcG9pbnQtbWlzc2lvbi1yZWNvcmRzLTAxNzU3LXBncy0yMy0yNC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=67a58a3c0cbab7ff2ca9bac6605892c00010f2e6232386049c7e4f39a5811b45]
from Gilland to members of the West Point Board of Visitors, Gilland
characterizes the MacArthur Society of West Point Graduates
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35311&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9tYWNhcnRodXJzb2NpZXR5Lm9yZy9hYm91dC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5cd7dffdc9f626ff0b4fabfc2d17d69d390d6c18561c88ea61780d9537dad02e]
as “a small but vocal group of
Academy alumni who criticize the Academy on our continued
transformation efforts.”

In a March 28, 2023, PowerPoint presentation
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35312&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLXdlc3QtcG9pbnQtbWlzc2lvbi1yZWNvcmRzLTAxNzU3LXBncy0xNzMtMjAzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=15348f58413fa4a788cddfb4b6a05f65e43169fe5716d64c3bbc317f09ad8050]
for a West Point Board of Visitors meeting, in a slide titled “Focus
Areas,” under the subtitle “Army Lines of Effort,” is a bullet
“Development and implementation of a DEI Plan informed by the
current D&I [Diversity and Inclusion] Plan (Middle States

In a July 27, 2023, U.S. Military Academy Board of Directors
PowerPoint presentation
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=35313&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLXdlc3QtcG9pbnQtbWlzc2lvbi1yZWNvcmRzLTAxNzU3LXBncy0yNjAtMjg4Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=74fafb62795b9746eb5da9f776d133b7ea0d02be1d67f88e108a07e9152c778e],
the one slide contains the bullet “Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
(DEI) at USMA.”

Judicial Watch is pushing relentlessly in federal court for the full
truth on the Biden’s regime war on traditional military values.

In November 2024, we filed a FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=33908&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVicmFuZGluZy13ZXN0LXBvaW50cy1kZWkvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=c728e93a2bde03895c312250b0ea829ba7254c4e7041608384ffccd65db91080]
against
the U.S. Department of Defense for information regarding the

In March 2023, records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=29154&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYWlyLWZvcmNlLWFjYWRlbXktZm9jdXMtb24tY3J0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=4caf6e703f5d606ec1200b50bc0794f7d9a84bd3c75277a5683d76b8d2763cfe]
from
the U.S. Department of Defense showed the U.S. Air Force Academy had
made race and gender instruction a top priority in the training of
cadets.

In July 2023, we exposed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=29831&F=T&&hash=a1d5d4d84b34bce02a40178ecf93402b0c36948055236ddfe9d403c671271f61]

In June 2022, we exposed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74318&L=27536&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY3J0LXByb3BhZ2FuZGEtYXQtd2VzdC1wb2ludC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=61298f14d739336b97230b419ac55e576f2e2a6a98ce23b8bdca56be0aeb2f62]
Critical
Race Theory (CRT) instruction at the U.S. Military Academy. One

USA.” [Emphasis in original]

clean_body: Even if it doesn’t become a federal law... | “Dozens of statesacross the country are considering their own versions of a federal voting bill critics say could disenfranchise millions of Americans” — USA Today Peter: The SAVE Act has been spreading to the states. From SB 153 in Ohio to SB 16 in Texas, there’s no shortage of copycat threats to our democracy, with new legislation that would add unnecessary burdens to the voting process. It’s clearer than ever that even if the SAVE Act doesn't make it through the U.S. Senate, anti-democracy extremists are using it as a blueprint to pass similar voter-suppression measures state by state. And it’s part of their agenda to undermine voters’ power, including distorting maps for partisan gain. THEN: The House of Representatives narrowly passed the SAVE Act — threatening to make it harder for military voters, rural voters, tribal citizens, survivors of natural disasters, people of color, working-class Americans, married women, and more to exercise their right to vote. This is an existential moment for voting rights in America. subject: Don't let the far-left dictate culture in our city or state
body:
Don't let the far-left dictate culture in our city or state. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/wsrp/please-support-wagops-election-integrity-efforts-2699058?e=6a281f566d)
---
| |
---
| | **"We do not let the far-left dictate culture in our state and our city"**
**Bellevue** —"What this group is doing here is essential to reassert what is good in our public commentary and discourse," said WAGOP Chairman Jim Walsh, at the “[Rattle in Seattle](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=4a1ada4158&e=6a281f566d)” on Tuesday. "It's pushing the pendulum back to the middle and recognizing everyone's first amendment right, under Article 1, sections 4 and 11 of the WA state Constitution to peaceably assemble to speak to important issues of the day."

The purpose of the rally was to hold Seattle Mayor Bruce Harrell accountable for siding with violent Antifa anarchists in the aftermath of an evangelical Christian gathering at Cal Anderson Park in Seattle’s Capitol Hill neighborhood. “We do not let the far-left dictate culture in our state and our city,” emphasized Chairman Walsh.

Thank you to all who attended the rally and for continuing to support the efforts of WAGOP.

Sincerely,

Matthew Frohlich
WAGOP Executive Director

| | |
---
---
| | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z54rdrs6aumbugv8a3g7gfif6m34jvq50uddqrb8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor1c5h2bs)
---
| | My Dear Friend, [**My name is Maud Maron, and I need your help to defeat Alvin Bragg and replace him as the District Attorney of Manhattan.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z6ir6m2bd3opm5qsc61k9tr5n8fh1fu287f0irv0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor1c5h2bs) You know Alvin... The George Soros elected, Pro-Criminal, Trump-Deranged DEI hire that has turned my beloved New York City into a third-world Hellscape.If you think that sounds too dramatic, just look at a few examples of what Alvin Bragg’s “weak-on-crime,” Trump-obsessed tenure has brought to the law-abiding citizens of New York:
---
* An innocent woman set on fire by a Guatemalan Illegal Alien who had already been deported at least once before...
* A mob of Illegal criminals caught on video assaulting two New York City Law Enforcement officers outside a “Migrant Shelter,” all **released without bail by Alvin Bragg!**

---
Instead of working for the last 4 years to make the Citizens of New York safe and secure, Alvin has been on a singular, sick, twisted mission and one mission only -- TAKE DOWN DONALD TRUMP.That’s what he ran on...Those were his marching orders from George Soros and his Radical donors...And those are orders he dutifully followed -- at the expense of not only those of us who live in New York, but every single American that deserved to vote in a fair election not tainted by a ridiculous set of trumped-up charges made up out of thin air.New Yorkers deserve better...Americans deserve better.That’s why -- whether you live right here in Manhattan, a thousand miles away in Des Moines, Iowa, or anywhere else in our great country -- I hope you’ll help me defeat Alvin Bragg. **[Would you consider helping my campaign with a one-time $28 contribution today?](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z8b56mb59pik71olc27jskosg9oojjqfv7mjg34g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor1c5h2bs)** I could really use your help.Alvin Bragg has millions of dollars pouring into his campaign by the same Radicals who put him there the first time around...
---
* George Soros
* Hollywood Celebrities
* Elites right here in New York and Hollywood
* The deep pockets of the Democrat election machine

---
I don’t have any of that on my side -- but I hope I’ve got YOU on my side.To have any chance of beating the Democrat machine funding Alvin Bragg’s run for re-election, I need a nationwide army of Americans to rally by my side...A nationwide army of Americans who understand how toxic it is having a Radical like Alvin Bragg in charge of the criminal justice system of one of our largest cities...Who know how close Alvin Bragg came to knocking Donald Trump out of the 2024 Presidential election and what that would have done to our country... Who watched in disgust as Alvin Bragg conjured up a 34-count felony conviction against a man whose only real crime was trying to Make America Great Again!This is our chance to send a clear message not only to the people of New York -- but the nation -- that these Radicals put into place by George Soros to do his bidding are not invincible...That they CAN be defeated! Alvin Bragg is the perfect example of why I left the Democrat party.I think it all started when my 11-year-old got COVID... We were told to mask in the house and give my son meals in his room for 10 days. Instead, we cuddled up & watched TV together -- unmasked in the living room and ate our meals as a family at the dinner table. That was a watershed moment for me.What were we doing?When did the United States of America turn into a place where the Government told us how to live?When I dared to suggest that it may not be the best idea for biological boys to participate in girls’ sports, I was all but run out of town on a rail... Then I dared suggest that the complete failure of our school system might be due to something other than racism, I -- after a lifetime of considering myself a liberal Democrat -- was labeled a “Right Wing Extremist” by the New York Times!The blinders came off -- suddenly, I realized that if simply acknowledging the truth, calling out corruption and challenging the long-held beliefs of the Democrat machine disqualified me from being a Democrat.The truth will set you free -- and it’s an honor to represent you on the “Freedom Side” of the wall.I’ve been in their camp.As a former Democrat and as a mom raising four kids in Manhattan. I know how much they are getting wrong. And how bad it is for our children. **[That’s why I’m asking good folks like you to help me.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zufu13vc357b3b44lo1v9leeq4t0blaesqqfhlh0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor1c5h2bs)** It’s going to take all of us to take down Alvin Bragg -- but this has been a season of political miracles!I humbly ask for your help today. I hope you’ll find it in your heart to send a one-time $28 contribution to help me pull off one more political miracle......and send Alvin Bragg back to obscurity where he belongs.He’s bad for New York...He’s bad for America...And he needs to go.One last favor...I know not everybody is going to be able to give that I write to today. **[So if you think you could spare a larger gift -- of $50, $100, $250, $500 or even $1,000 or more, a few of those would really help right now.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zdhc74ko0os5fv5n14fqisub2c74j7a4hmdav9e8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor1c5h2bs)** We need a good, strong launch -- and without a few of those larger gifts, we’ll already be behind.Please just send what you can, My Friend.Just reading my email today is a tremendous favor, and I really appreciate it.Thank you, Wish Me Luck, and God Bless You!
---
---
**Maud Maron**

P.S. I guess Alvin Bragg has just been too darn busy to concentrate on the wave of crime and violence washing over New York...While he has spent the last 4 years prosecuting and persecuting President Trump, New York has become a third-world hellscape!New York deserves better...Our Country deserves better...

Will you help me take the place of Alvin Bragg by supporting my campaign to become the District Attorney of Manhattan?**[If so, please rush a one-time gift of $28, $50, $100, $250, $500 or even $1,000 or more -- I could really use your help!](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zild64uvrbtsrimfh0c8bk4qi2iiief1lqo01ueg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor1c5h2bs)**

name: Mark Jennings
subject: He’s lost everything
body:
Let me tell you what happened so you can decide if you’ll join me in fighting for an innocent man...

| | |
---
FriendRadical Soros-backed prosecutor Aisha Braveboy has launched a political witch-hunt against my police officer son-in-law.That’s a photo of him -- Sgt. Robert Warrington of Bowie, MD -- with his dog, Rooster.
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z29nud8cldbu7i11o6ont02moh9vqu60vi9avejo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6clh2bs)
---
The day Robert asked for my daughter’s hand in marriage was one of the proudest days of my life. I couldn’t have chosen a better man for my baby girl if I tried. Even though we lost my daughter in 2020 after a long battle with breast cancer, Robert and I have remained close. He’s like a son to me and there’s nothing I won’t do for him.**[That’s why I’m swallowing my pride and asking you, a perfect stranger, for help.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsu4onbvvqv2gpj30jjmr0umn9cc9ci7rfi7cl8g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6clh2bs)** Let me tell you what happened so you can decide if you’ll join me in fighting for an innocent man...Last September, Robert stopped to assist a vehicle that appeared to be broken down.As he stepped out of his police car, a man walked right in front of Robert. But when Robert asked if he was with the disabled car, the man did not stop or even acknowledge him.**Then suddenly, the man pivoted to face Robert and stretched his right hand away from his body with a black object in his hand.** If you’ve spent any time around law enforcement officers, then you know they are trained to quickly assess a situation and take necessary action to defend themselves. Robert didn’t know why this car was pulled to the side of the road -- nor did he know who was in it.But he knew that traffic stops are one of the most dangerous situations for a cop to respond to -- so when this man appeared to pull a gun on him, Robert didn’t hesitate.He fired one shot. The bullet did not strike the man. Thank goodness, as Robert later discovered he was unarmed!Why the man pulled out his cell phone and pointed it at my son-in-law, we may never know...But the bottom line is _no one was hurt._ **Unfortunately, that didn’t stop the local prosecutor from swooping in and charging Robert with** **_Attempted Murder_.**It didn’t make any sense until we learned the prosecutor was backed by George Soros and she was campaigning for higher office on an anti-cop platform. Surely prosecuting a decorated police officer would win over the radical base here in left-leaning Prince George’s County, Maryland.Like I said at the beginning of my letter, it’s a political witch-hunt.Robert’s trial is scheduled for September 2025. **He faces up to 30 years in prison.** My son-in-law has already lost so much. I can’t sit idly by and watch a radical prosecutor steal his career away from him, too.**[That’s why I’m humbly asking you to make a donation to help pay for Robert’s legal defense.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zaf52o1pfn6fqdmb6tdm4dpaajme98r1kq9n1pto_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6clh2bs) **I’m going to be blunt. The attorneys anticipate it’ll cost over $150,000 to get through the trial. Robert just doesn’t have that kind of money.It was difficult enough to pay the medical bills following my daughter’s four-year battle with cancer on a police officer’s salary. I’ve helped as much as I can, and I was starting to worry when we got a call from a local man named Jason Johnson.It turns out Jason is a retired Prince George’s County Police Officer. And now he runs the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).It was truly an answer to a prayer. For over thirty years, the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) has provided legal defenses to wrongly accused police officers like Robert.They pay for attorneys’ fees, expert witnesses, investigators, other court costs, and more.LELDF has successfully helped hundreds of officers clear their names and win back their freedom. And now they’re helping Robert mount the defense he deserves.But they can’t do it alone. **[That’s why I’m praying you’ll find it in your heart to help LELDF fight for Robert.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ze5ok93um9iileigi8lol829gmcv87sq55k3sbq0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6clh2bs)** It may not seem like your gift of $35, $50, or even $100 will make a difference with that huge of a sum.But when combined with donations from thousands of other folks who are moved by our story, LELDF will be able to raise the resources to pay for Robert’s case. [**Will you please help fight for Robert by donating $35, $50, $100, or more to LELDF today?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zt6kbdq178m2e65nsjltil3juddv6tda49r9n3e0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6clh2bs) LELDF is a non-profit organization which means your gift today is tax-deductible. And you can rest assured your gift will be put to immediate use helping Robert and other wrongly accused officers win in court and move on with their lives as free men.Frankly, I was shocked to learn LELDF is supporting several officers who are also being railroaded by Soros-backed anti-cop prosecutors. It’s unconscionable! As a father, I wish more than anything that I could snap my fingers and make this all go away for Robert. But since I can’t, I’m doing what any father would do – I’m fighting for my son with all I’ve got.So no matter what you’re able to give to LELDF today, please pray for Robert and our family. We really need some good news right now.Thank you in advance for your generous support.
---
Gratefully,
---
Mark Jennings
---
P.S. I saw Robert’s true character while my daughter -- his wife -- battled breast cancer. He is a good man who would lay down is life for another without hesitation. Five years after my daughter’s death, I still consider Robert my son and there’s nothing I won’t do for him. Our family has already lost so much. Robert’s freedom and good name -- not to mention his career -- are on the line. Please don’t let a desperate Soros-backed prosecutor steal all he has left. **[Help us fight back by donating $35, $50, $100, or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zg0stpsutikifo0prpbv7bim6lq0dp1ite0l0iag_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6clh2bs).** Thank you!
---
|
---

The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit. And remember –Blue Lives Matter!_ © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | [www.PoliceDefense.org](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z88g3b499mndmtb6cb46rlqtbin0nsnhv9jcith0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6clh2bs)

Robert just doesn’t have that kind of money.It was difficult enough to pay the medical bills following my daughter’s four-year battle with cancer on a police officer’s salary. I’ve helped as much as I can, and I was starting to worry when we got a call from a local man named Jason Johnson.It turns out Jason is a retired Prince George’s County Police Officer. And now he runs the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).It was truly an answer to a prayer. For over thirty years, the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) has provided legal defenses to wrongly accused police officers like Robert.They pay for attorneys’ fees, expert witnesses, investigators, other court costs, and more.LELDF has successfully helped hundreds of officers clear their names and win back their freedom. And now they’re helping Robert mount the defense he deserves.But they can’t do it alone. It may not seem like your gift of $35, $50, or even $100 will make a difference with that huge of a sum.But when combined with donations from thousands of other folks who are moved by our story, LELDF will be able to raise the resources to pay for Robert’s case. LELDF is a non-profit organization which means your gift today is tax-deductible. And you can rest assured your gift will be put to immediate use helping Robert and other wrongly accused officers win in court and move on with their lives as free men.Frankly, I was shocked to learn LELDF is supporting several officers who are also being railroaded by Soros-backed anti-cop prosecutors. It’s unconscionable! As a father, I wish more than anything that I could snap my fingers and make this all go away for Robert. But since I can’t, I’m doing what any father would do – I’m fighting for my son with all I’ve got.So no matter what you’re able to give to LELDF today, please pray for Robert and our family. We really need some good news right now.Thank you in advance for your generous support. Gratefully, Mark Jennings P.S. I saw Robert’s true character while my daughter -- his wife -- battled breast cancer. He is a good man who would lay down is life for another without hesitation. Five years after my daughter’s death, I still consider Robert my son and there’s nothing I won’t do for him. Our family has already lost so much. Robert’s freedom and good name -- not to mention his career -- are on the line. Please don’t let a desperate Soros-backed prosecutor steal all he has left. . Thank you! | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. name: Charlie Kirk, Turning Point USA
subject: They said it was impossible...
body:
You didn’t just believe in us. You built us.

| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z3n3suo8qkletdvcvh0eam3q86c996hhlo8g5tlg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6cph2bs)
---
Friend, We recently wrapped up one of Turning Point USA’s latest stops on the American Comeback Tour at UC San Diego... I wish you could have been there to see it. Another packed quad. Students eager to listen. Flags waving. Cheers for America. Energy you could feel in your bones. _Not in Texas... Not in Florida..._ **_California._** The “Deep Blue” stronghold the Left said we’d never touch. But we did. And we’ll keep going. **Because of patriots like you.**
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z7ft72pqnnm5qjurg6u3q0c5dc1537bf1mmogh68_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6cph2bs)
---
As I stood there looking out at the crowd — hundreds of young patriots rising up in a place the Left said they owned — I couldn’t help but think... **Nearly 13 years ago, all of this felt...****_impossible._** Back then, Turning Point USA wasn’t the cultural phenomenon it is today.It wasn’t an office. It wasn’t a team. _It was just me._ No money. No connections. Just a desk and an old computer in a dusty garage in the Chicago suburbs._But what I did have was a vision..._ It was 2012. The Left controlled every classroom, every campus, and nearly every corner of our culture.Their narrative was everywhere: America was evil... Faith was “oppressive”... Freedom was outdated... The Conservative movement was dead... _And most of all, young people belonged to the Left._**I didn’t believe that. I couldn’t accept that. I couldn’t just stand by and watch the Left win.** Back then, it was no wonder WHY we were losing young people to the Left...The Conservative movement felt stale... Conservative organizations felt like a snooze... And it felt like no one had an idea of how to reach America’s youth... I believed if we were ever going to win young people back for America, we needed excitement. Energy. Passion. And ZEAL for our ideas.**My dream was to launch a conservative youth movement that would inspire young people to stand for truth — and LOVE this country again.** I didn’t know what I was going to call this dream... this feeling... this movement.So, I picked up the phone, called my dad, and said, “I think I’m supposed to start something, but I don’t have a name for it...” **He replied...****_"How about Turning Point?"_** And just like that, a fire was lit. Turning Point USA was born. On the promise that we could TURN this country around, one young heart at a time. The early days were brutal.I remember driving across the Chicago suburbs to small Tea Party meetings talking about “generational theft”... I remember my first Turning Point USA speaking event in Peoria, Illinois during the summer of 2012, where just six people showed up...**And I remember the look in their eyes — those early patriots —****when I told them the vision:**_“We’re going to create a youth movement that LOVES America.”_ _“We’re going to go on campus and win hearts and minds.”_ _“We’re going to push back — and we’re going to WIN.”_ They didn’t laugh... They didn’t walk out...**They believed. And Friend — so did patriots like you.**
---
You see, this isn’t my story. This is YOUR story.Because without patriots like you... _there is no Turning Point USA._ Without you... _there is no American Comeback story._ Without you... _there is no cultural shift happening right now in schools, churches, homes, and on every campus across our great nation._ You were there when the campus quads and halls were empty... stood by us when our signs got torn down. You had our backs when the mob showed up — when they shouted, screamed, and tried to wipe us off the map.**You didn’t give up. And neither did we.** But we were never supposed to be winning...The Left thought they owned this generation. They thought their indoctrination had worked. _But they were wrong._ I remember standing at tables on hostile campuses with nothing but flyers and hope, praying to have a conversation that would light a spark. I went where I was told a young conservative didn’t belong. And I kept going back.
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2znco0jbvb5qd7qi0n83brioc9cg8vp66rjfhbqng_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6cph2bs)
---
**And then... something happened...** **_The students started listening._** They started to question everything, think for themselves, and no longer be afraid to stand up. Then, they started showing up. _In DROVES._ And now? We’re not just watching history unfold... you and I are making it. **Friend, just LOOK at the movement we’ve built:** 🔥 A network of 820,000+ conservative student activists
🔥 1,800+ college and high school chapters
🔥 All 50 states. No territory unclaimed.🔥 16 BILLION+ total views across online platforms🔥 5 MILLION+ daily viewers online
🔥 Over 10 million young people turned away from the Left
🔥 Students rising up — even in DEEP blue states Friend, we’re not just winning arguments and “owning the libs” anymore... We’re winning hearts. We’re changing minds. We’re turning the tide. This generation wasn’t “lost.” _They were LIED to._ **But because of patriots like YOU — they’re hearing the truth. They’re finding their voices. They’re discovering their courage. They’re falling in love with this country again!**
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zsc1i1n660ep7miq8itan2118oivlnt8ntstrdkg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6cph2bs)
---
_Friend, praise God!_ And you know what? This generation is just getting started.**But let me say this clearly: The battle is far from over.** The Left is on the ropes — but still dangerous.They’re doubling down with new tactics. They’re more aggressive than ever in our schools, our media, our digital spaces. They’re coming after our students harder than ever before — because they know we’re winning._We cannot give them back an inch._ So now, as we look back on how far we’ve come... It’s time to fight even harder.We’re going to press in. We’re going to drive deeper into enemy territory.**We’re going to reach more students, train more leaders, and destroy more strongholds of Leftist control.** Not with violence. Not with hate. But with truth. With courage. And with patriots like YOU standing shoulder-to-shoulder with us.
---
Friend, I want you to feel proud as you read this today. Because this movement — the energy, the fire, the growth, the headlines — it belongs to patriots like you... The grassroots patriots who lit the match... fanned the flames... stood in the gap. **And now, we’re raising up the most Conservative, most Patriotic, most fired-up youth generation in 50 years.** That’s not hype. That’s reality. And it’s only possible because of our proud supporters, people like you, who never gave up. **I can’t say thank you enough to the patriots who’ve fought alongside us... those who loved this country enough to invest in its future... those who believed this country was worth saving.** Let’s keep our foot on the gas. Let’s keep changing minds. Let’s keep winning this culture war. Because we were never supposed to be winning... And yet here we are. For America, Charlie Kirk
Founder & CEO
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zv3l7cuibitdul3uodco7e3nb7cdqdn5vt3gvtq0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6cph2bs)
---
**P.S.** Friend, thank you for reading what was admittedly a long email.But I wanted you to know how far we’ve come and how thankful I am for patriots like you! And if this email stirred something in you... If you’d be proud to be a part of the movement that’s going to save our GREAT nation...If you want to see even MORE students come alive for truth, for God, and for America... Then I have good news.**Right now, through the month of May, every single donation to Turning Point USA is being MATCHED, dollar-for-dollar, up to $2.5 MILLION.** Why? Because an extremely generous Turning Point USA supporter wanted to rally as many grassroots patriots as possible to DEFEAT the Left in our culture... for good.That means your impact gets DOUBLED. **That means two times the students you’ll reach. Two times the truth heard. Two times the hearts and minds you’ll win over for AMERICA.** So, if you’ve been waiting for the right moment to take your stand — this is it. This is your chance to pour fuel on the fire that patriots like you helped start.You just won’t be supporting a cause anymore — you’ll be powering a cultural REVOLUTION. _**[Let’s carry the momentum through to every campus, every platform, every cultural stronghold until we WIN. Double the impact of your gift to Turning Point USA today.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zjrc994n0m3k6pbm1avbbhdn6bss84nge742r28g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6cph2bs)**_
---

**DOUBLE Your Impact**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ze81u6f5r4t4uqlam2jfdjfjt44e7i45mtkisti8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdgeaor6cph2bs)

The Conservative movement was dead... _And most of all, young people belonged to the Left._**I didn’t believe that. I couldn’t accept that. I couldn’t just stand by and watch the Left win.** Back then, it was no wonder WHY we were losing young people to the Left...The Conservative movement felt stale... Conservative organizations felt like a snooze... And it felt like no one had an idea of how to reach America’s youth... I believed if we were ever going to win young people back for America, we needed excitement. Energy. Passion. And ZEAL for our ideas.**My dream was to launch a conservative youth movement that would inspire young people to stand for truth — and LOVE this country again.** I didn’t know what I was going to call this dream... this feeling... this movement.So, I picked up the phone, called my dad, and said, “I think I’m supposed to start something, but I don’t have a name for it...” **He replied...****_"How about Turning Point?"_** And just like that, a fire was lit. Turning Point USA was born. On the promise that we could TURN this country around, one young heart at a time. The early days were brutal.I remember driving across the Chicago suburbs to small Tea Party meetings talking about “generational theft”... I remember my first Turning Point USA speaking event in Peoria, Illinois during the summer of 2012, where just six people showed up...**And I remember the look in their eyes — those early patriots —****when I told them the vision:**_“We’re going to create a youth movement that LOVES America.”_ _“We’re going to go on campus and win hearts and minds.”_ _“We’re going to push back — and we’re going to WIN.”_ They didn’t laugh... They didn’t walk out...**They believed. And Friend — so did patriots like you.**

I went where I was told a young conservative didn’t belong. And I kept going back.

They’re falling in love with this country again!**

| | Fellow Conservative,Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to **[sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zksomfog9dtvntn3006gg7os1oqmo98foiisd8a0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdge6pb6c5h2bs)** If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed.The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.”Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series.And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family – for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!**[**I hope you see why I need your help today.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zio2rb4ttap65u77rdl4qhj24b1r69gtatohekn8_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdge6pb6c5h2bs)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome **Brave Books** that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves.>> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), **Brave Books** was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile.In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible.But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking **Brave Books** how they could host Story Hours of their own.And that’s how our nationwide “See You at the Library Day” was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 360 libraries in 45 states.On the same day, we held hundreds of Story Hours to fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.**I went to as many "See You at the Library" events as I could in one day to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots...**...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries.And this year, our ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to over 1,000 libraries reaching over 100,000 children.The exact date in August will soon be announced. And before then, what we need is you!It’s going to be expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold Story Hours for 100+ children at each library – that's 100,000+ children in all. **[That’s why I hope you’ll give a sponsorship gift of $175, $350, $525 or more today.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zif5e3o9j3lvsnlnigfecjqdvj596ebklhcbjjpo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdge6pb6c5h2bs)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library Day” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items.**Brave Books** is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA.Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our 1,000 Story Hours to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, **[**please consider a sponsorship gift of $175.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z54rkpv1gs60i6pe2a2sl85mkdt1eiopbp3o1sgg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdge6pb6c5h2bs)** That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. **[Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $175, or anything higher or lower please get your sponsorship gift in within the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we can get into this August!](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zsftuovmnfm3morgls20c3uqq2k22mevruqtbqgo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdge6pb6c5h2bs)**

# **Upcoming IBLC Town Hall**
---
| | |
---
I cannot wait to join my colleagues in the Indiana Black Legislative Caucus (IBLC) at the first stop of our town hall series right here in Indianapolis.

**All are welcome** as we break down legislation, answer your questions about this past session, address your concerns about our state, and work together to find solutions.

I'm excited to see you there next Saturday, **June 7** at**Kountry Kitchen** on 1**831 N. College Ave** from **12-2 p.m.! **

---
| | [Register for the Town Hall Here!](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=4a375c57441642e2ba04adc9b1b5640a870f4b668b1763e841a11d8acab18fa3c34d8158fa9165c93f1df67b1b3985121072a90104879c8c)

| | |
# Summer Meal Assistance Still Available to Hoosier Kids
---
| | I was profoundly disappointed when it was [announced that Indiana was opting out of the SUN Bucks program,](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=4a375c57441642e2c175cd5c7b49b533e9dc3066580d802b634d60763a2739959e5d8cea7bdafdff21ca98081f6eb06131f6769811dc76a0 "announced that Indiana was opting out of the SUN Bucks program,") which gave families who need assistance [$120 per child ](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=4a375c57441642e21067aeb65e2400a69252f4f54ba0edd83daed6b1b95d7492f17b845b25bb9f2f3f6c6d5d17ea048d4006e52269ffa363 "$120 per child") to help with the cost of summertime groceries.

41% of parents struggle in some way to provide food for their children when school is out, and, with rising grocery costs, this program offered a bit of relief for 669,000 children in our state.
## Despite this significant loss, free summer meal programs are still available

# Upcoming IMPD Listening Sessions
---
| | |
---
As a part of developing a new five-year strategic plan, IMPD is hosting a series of listening session to promote honest feedback and perspective on the department.

This is a wonderful opportunity to get involved in your community and play a role in its future.

**Unable to attend in person? Complete the community survey[here](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=4a375c57441642e2d4a13cdc9ddcc4cbca808eeea6fe7df08eee73df69180bf5f0395cd192329a67c7096c88b7afe03adec23e1f8654299b "here"). **

Post-Session Legislation Overview

| | | | [](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=4a375c57441642e20d6b0c89cfd46e887dec47df8d80c97e80b228c555089720d60e6d7a159fe297e37fdc492d539235aca3962d3cbc735f)

---
Above you can find a quick breakdown of some our wins from this legislative session, as well as some of the legislation that we advocated against.

This past session my colleagues and I worked hard to support legislation that will better Indiana for all who call it home.

Whether it is **addressing the health care needs of both the present and future** , **protecting consumers in the landscape of emerging industries** or**working to improve the lives of the most vulnerable** , the Senate Democrats spent this past session fighting for every Hoosier family.

In the same breath, we fought hard all session against legislation that takes us backwards as a state and neglects those who need the most help.

The Indiana Senate Democrats are already hard at work connecting with constituents to inform our legislative priorities for next session as we continue fighting for the future Hoosiers deserve.
**For more information on these bills, or any others, visit[iga.in.gov](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=4a375c57441642e2561046daaf3864a5982b8a3074ab994c03fe9597b2f00feb64ac8a9b00981853aa9b8c401b30e9e8e0c8eb5c622e0d39 "iga.in.gov").**

| | |
# **Liberating Minds: African American Literature and Libraries **
---
| | |
---
We are**two weeks** away from the 8th Annual Book Fest & Juneteenth Celebration!

Now, as much as ever, it is critical that we find opportunities to come together to celebrate ourselves, our culture and the unmistakable impact our voices have had on the literature of this country.

To learn more, and to get information on tickets for a moderated conversation with Mychal Threets, click [here](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=4d013cff99a98882a90b83f6dd3d9c3236a55fc77dcdbeba7ff2462a099d2e130e048ac4455ac1dd50b6c0175fc409bb2b010358945135b5 "here").

name: Mark Jennings
subject: He’s lost everything
body:
Let me tell you what happened so you can decide if you’ll join me in fighting for an innocent man...

| | |
---
FriendRadical Soros-backed prosecutor Aisha Braveboy has launched a political witch-hunt against my police officer son-in-law.That’s a photo of him -- Sgt. Robert Warrington of Bowie, MD -- with his dog, Rooster.
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdv0876q6cbat04lato6573tcos3apd301i6pvao_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdie4o75c1h2bs)
---
The day Robert asked for my daughter’s hand in marriage was one of the proudest days of my life. I couldn’t have chosen a better man for my baby girl if I tried. Even though we lost my daughter in 2020 after a long battle with breast cancer, Robert and I have remained close. He’s like a son to me and there’s nothing I won’t do for him.**[That’s why I’m swallowing my pride and asking you, a perfect stranger, for help.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgn6tdlse40lr5ohinlqr9k39ctdsnerej5sdibo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdie4o75c1h2bs)** Let me tell you what happened so you can decide if you’ll join me in fighting for an innocent man...Last September, Robert stopped to assist a vehicle that appeared to be broken down.As he stepped out of his police car, a man walked right in front of Robert. But when Robert asked if he was with the disabled car, the man did not stop or even acknowledge him.**Then suddenly, the man pivoted to face Robert and stretched his right hand away from his body with a black object in his hand.** If you’ve spent any time around law enforcement officers, then you know they are trained to quickly assess a situation and take necessary action to defend themselves. Robert didn’t know why this car was pulled to the side of the road -- nor did he know who was in it.But he knew that traffic stops are one of the most dangerous situations for a cop to respond to -- so when this man appeared to pull a gun on him, Robert didn’t hesitate.He fired one shot. The bullet did not strike the man. Thank goodness, as Robert later discovered he was unarmed!Why the man pulled out his cell phone and pointed it at my son-in-law, we may never know...But the bottom line is _no one was hurt._ **Unfortunately, that didn’t stop the local prosecutor from swooping in and charging Robert with** **_Attempted Murder_.**It didn’t make any sense until we learned the prosecutor was backed by George Soros and she was campaigning for higher office on an anti-cop platform. Surely prosecuting a decorated police officer would win over the radical base here in left-leaning Prince George’s County, Maryland.Like I said at the beginning of my letter, it’s a political witch-hunt.Robert’s trial is scheduled for September 2025. **He faces up to 30 years in prison.** My son-in-law has already lost so much. I can’t sit idly by and watch a radical prosecutor steal his career away from him, too.**[That’s why I’m humbly asking you to make a donation to help pay for Robert’s legal defense.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zv4j0jp4dtqb24av12u2uaimh7c9cfvv71vspg4g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdie4o75c1h2bs) **I’m going to be blunt. The attorneys anticipate it’ll cost over $150,000 to get through the trial. Robert just doesn’t have that kind of money.It was difficult enough to pay the medical bills following my daughter’s four-year battle with cancer on a police officer’s salary. I’ve helped as much as I can, and I was starting to worry when we got a call from a local man named Jason Johnson.It turns out Jason is a retired Prince George’s County Police Officer. And now he runs the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).It was truly an answer to a prayer. For over thirty years, the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) has provided legal defenses to wrongly accused police officers like Robert.They pay for attorneys’ fees, expert witnesses, investigators, other court costs, and more.LELDF has successfully helped hundreds of officers clear their names and win back their freedom. And now they’re helping Robert mount the defense he deserves.But they can’t do it alone. **[That’s why I’m praying you’ll find it in your heart to help LELDF fight for Robert.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmjflnon63g70vt6s8ep993eg89v91rt4ue07f6g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdie4o75c1h2bs)** It may not seem like your gift of $35, $50, or even $100 will make a difference with that huge of a sum.But when combined with donations from thousands of other folks who are moved by our story, LELDF will be able to raise the resources to pay for Robert’s case. [**Will you please help fight for Robert by donating $35, $50, $100, or more to LELDF today?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6vq7ms9l7n5rnf5bci3dkm1ti0ef43chqqkbre0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdie4o75c1h2bs) LELDF is a non-profit organization which means your gift today is tax-deductible. And you can rest assured your gift will be put to immediate use helping Robert and other wrongly accused officers win in court and move on with their lives as free men.Frankly, I was shocked to learn LELDF is supporting several officers who are also being railroaded by Soros-backed anti-cop prosecutors. It’s unconscionable! As a father, I wish more than anything that I could snap my fingers and make this all go away for Robert. But since I can’t, I’m doing what any father would do – I’m fighting for my son with all I’ve got.So no matter what you’re able to give to LELDF today, please pray for Robert and our family. We really need some good news right now.Thank you in advance for your generous support.
---
Gratefully,
---
Mark Jennings
---
P.S. I saw Robert’s true character while my daughter -- his wife -- battled breast cancer. He is a good man who would lay down is life for another without hesitation. Five years after my daughter’s death, I still consider Robert my son and there’s nothing I won’t do for him. Our family has already lost so much. Robert’s freedom and good name -- not to mention his career -- are on the line. Please don’t let a desperate Soros-backed prosecutor steal all he has left. **[Help us fight back by donating $35, $50, $100, or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z11ibh3p3203pch5hl7umeuup7lh4c507o579a3o_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sdie4o75c1h2bs).** Thank you!
---
|
---

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Wealth inequality has gotten so bad in this country that greedy,
self-interested millionaires like Shri Thanedar can buy Congressional
seats.

Since using his personal fortune to become the U.S. Representative of
Michigan’s 13th district, Shri has been busy pulling selfish media stunts
while ghosting his constituents, who have resorted to calling other
representatives for assistance.

And just how rich is Shri, anyway? With an estimated net worth of $41
million, here are the facts:

* Shri is the 10th richest Democrat in Congress
* Shri is one of the 20 richest members in the House of Representatives
* Shri is one of the 30 richest members of Congress

Millionaires like Shri think that their fortune entitles them to power, no
matter how poorly they serve the people they were elected to represent.
Justice Democrats is working to change that in 2026, starting with his
district.

We’re fed up with a Democratic Party overrun by wealthy, do-nothing
Democratic incumbents like Shri, which is why we’re supporting
progressive, working-class candidates like Donavan McKinney to challenge
them in the upcoming primary elections.

While Shri has his personal wealth paired with the backing of corporate
super PACs willing to dump millions into this race, we rely on grassroots
contributions from people like YOU to take on the powerful and win.

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T93c0c78f-cd2b-4522-9782-6a9feba6ad86/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
| Peter, It’s Randy Bryce: You might remember me as the “Iron Stache,” the union Ironworker, veteran, and Democrat who took on Paul Ryan and helped escort him out the door. You were an important part of the movement we started to build in 2018, but we have more work to do. That’s why I’ve officially launched my campaign for Congress in Wisconsin’s 1st Congressional District against MAGA crony and Paul Ryan protege, Bryan Steil. [**Take a look at my launch video, “Job’s Not Done,” and let me know what you think:**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7f12f01b-c639-4530-95b5-8e779903b75c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **[](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4efad89f-2373-46cf-a58c-7b0b818ec2b7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
---
| | [WATCH HERE >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbce2684a-d672-4b71-acb2-3eda401639cf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Let’s be honest: There’s a war on the Middle Class and it didn’t start with Trump – but it sure is getting worse. With the help of yes-men like Steil, the billionaires are winning and on the backs of working people. As our jobs continue to be shipped overseas, wages still stagnant, and unions are gutted, Trump and Steil continue to attack what’s left of the American Dream. They are coming for our healthcare, our retirement, and our public schools. _I couldn’t stand by and watch the problems facing the Middle Class continue to get worse while Bryan Steil sits back and does nothing _– _except keep voting to let it happen. So I decided to throw my hat back in the ring and show them what we can do together._ I’ve spent my life on construction sites – not in backrooms with lobbyists. I don’t have a trust fund. I’ve beaten back cancer. I’ve taken care of a sick parent. I’ve served my country in the Army. I know what it means to struggle – and I know what it means to fight. Bryan Steil has sold us out to the billionaires. He’s voted to rip away healthcare from seniors and the disabled. He’s stood by while MAGA extremists tore apart our farm economy, wrecked our supply chains, and pushed tax breaks for the ultra-rich, all while plotting to SLASH Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security. Me? I’m in construction, not demolition. And I believe in building something that lasts:
— Jobs with dignity
— Healthcare as a human right FOR EVERYONE
— And PROTECTING Social Security, Medicaid, and Medicare from destruction But I can’t do this alone. This campaign is powered by people, not Super PACs. That’s how we took on Paul Ryan. And it’s how we’re going to defeat Bryan Steil. Make no mistake about it, this IS a winnable seat. This is a battleground district that is moving our way, and people are FED UP with Steil. _If Democrats want to retake the House, flipping WI-01 is the BEST place to start._ **[Can you make a donation RIGHT NOW to my campaign and Blue Amp Action so we can build this thing from the ground up? We’ve set an ambitious goal of adding 200 Grassroots Donors before midnight tonight – and I’m counting on you to help us get there. $25, $50, or even $100 will help us start this campaign on the right foot.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Taa6a45dc-93f0-4642-980c-11d6d2512406/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
---
| | [BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a7e5069-0505-42cb-936d-c90402896c21/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Randy “Iron Stache” Bryce

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. The migrants, from Cuba, Haiti, Nicaragua, and Venezuela were allowed into the U.S. as a result of a parole program set up by the Biden administration. Trump revoked that program, but a lower court had blocked his order until today's ruling.

Justices Ketanji Brown Jackson and Sonia Sotomayor, two of the court’s three liberal justices, [dissented from the court’s decision,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ugzAUBeCnMRuRucb8DB66sKVrR2Tja3B7wci-SZS3r9I8QudPOkfnfF3nq40Uj_XT7mg4pPnARyFkxjzHI5DlmI5gicoLGJHY5hkk6FrqWjWzt5Gec1t5ExABVYWm6duhGzoYhmozHkAqPeAwLl1YVI_SK-l065wHaOVYRfNKk1o1jWwa6C7LiK6zOvRuWEYXWtFK9JFTvnynePCGgZ7pjvmypL0iszGfRagPAZOAiTfcItHLBEwZ19t7goBpSbfMtbPMhEXApBXoDsa63M6MO9Zvz3hPP1jqPa7ZHlyfNidCAVOVjT8fkSiWrhetXHcb_3oq_tdxdwO_AQAA__9GYoPF) but the third, Justice Elena Kagan, joined with the majority.

The ruling comes two weeks after the court also allowed the administration to revoke the status of nearly 350,000 Venezuelans.
