The Texas layoffs go into effect July 15, impacting employees at Permian Basin, the top-producing oilfield in the U.S. Chevron announced in February that it would lay off up to 9,000 of its employees worldwide in order cut costs and “simplify our organizational structure.” Since then, Chevron’s license to operate in Venezuela has been [revoked](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd1gwxgYKim3cZdstLWyGmF1iIiAh_vtVove-4NVHmjnn_rksFxtiOK6_7Q1Nffm0HNhKxFoxL9uOz5yOaM_kfan4sqWFo5T7AgxGykY68MXZEM9FdM6szGneoeFSqEnpgfNuN3LzKCRjysnVSQ0TF5v126QnpbT30AXzPsbGgXPOuBC9Bjly4RRTGiZlLREMXagp93XHj4SPZ3pi7rd066LZa70XMvwiMBOYW2t9xkfFXN6cwLw-SjiwlDdMOTpqK20p_yMwfwXS7VHpgTbHkyrG6N-0Fvr5RL9DQRGYu2zcvYUYQ5kkEex6syF-LOrPtnsa-B8AAP__TdSDDg) and has announced the termination of 600 positions in California.
## Texas Teen Wins National Spelling Bee
Faizan Zaki, a seventh grader from Allen, Texas, took home the Scripps National Spelling Bee title on Thursday night, [successfully spelling “éclaircissement” for the win](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQRp8Gd1gw4B8Kim3osu2WCMI4RkvAMiiO8_RXzivcbqSRjs53_t3szcUU8-Ove6Ju76XYjEdN2Bru9r7iay85ubMsS234dvWIudbNAoOBsoEKboOL6bSyC9qzoHiHmk9yHmclOO9WjQon4WEYBxnYzCYuvFRe8gUc9164LuoLxgbBOWdcyl7BNHAZZjYrGGfniGQYYit731b8SizpLC_c-3t5dkmvrW2ViD8EDAFzHEePdcvXk4C5TgKmtrKfBIwlYGIgYOQgZqHYRMB8kbQhZrq4-HGZftz_SK-ltG6YrjzUI3a7DtsRU4p1nIhkj6eL6evQflfupeEnAAD__1Efgfg) and a $50,000 prize. ## Suburbs Shine in Best Places to Live List

Streets once bustling with families and small businesses are now overrun by _violent criminals_ and ___illegal aliens_ _._ Even _radical pro-terrorist extremists_ are occupying our college campuses, spitting in the faces of Jewish students and chanting for the destruction of America.

**_[I’m launching the Flip NY Red Fund, because I refuse to let the radical Left destroy the state I love without a fight](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ayhk/?__vbtrk=MjkzMjAyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzMjAyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**

But my team and I can’t do it alone. We need support and resources from across the country to help us lay the foundation for victory.
**_[That’s why I am humbly asking you to please rush whatever you can spare today to the Flip NY Red Fund to help us break the hold radical Democrats have on New York](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ayhk/?__vbtrk=MjkzMjAyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzMjAyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**
****Friend, if we can save the Empire State, we can save America.
[FLIP NY RED](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ayhk/?__vbtrk=MjkzMjAyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzMjAyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

_Your fellow patriot,_

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Mississippi’s New Budget: Transparent, Responsible, and Conservative
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://us18.campaign-archive.com/?e=5703353baa&u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=9db29271a3)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend, **This week, Mississippi lawmakers returned for a Special Session to finalize the state’s budget after failing to reach an agreement during the regular session.** The result: a more conservative budget.

**For years, Mississippi’s budgets were decided behind closed doors over a single weekend during the session.** Speaker Jason White and the House changed that by demanding an open, public process.

**Speaker White’s commitment to transparency paid off.** When Governor Tate Reeves called the Special Session, he urged fiscal restraint. This matters because Mississippi’s general fund has grown far faster than inflation since 2020.

**Lawmakers listened, passing a $7.1 billion budget — a modest increase from last year and one of the most fiscally responsible in recent years.**

Here are the main big spend items:

* **Education: $3.3 billion** , a slight increase to support our schools.
* **Transportation: $1.4 billion** from the general fund, plus $400 million from other sources.
* **Corrections: $431 million** , up from $407 million, to improve our dysfunctional prison system.
* **Unspent Funds: Nearly $1 billion left untouched** , demonstrating fiscal discipline.

**Speaker Jason White was right all along.** When lawmakers decide the budget in public through a proper process, they are more careful with our money. **Sunlight truly is the best disinfectant.**

**One subplot to the budget saga merits attention.** Some Senate members made a misguided attempt to cut basic funding for the State Auditor’s department, hindering its ability to function. This echoed attempts by leftist politicians in Washington, D.C., to block DOGE from auditing federal funds.

**Every conservative in Mississippi should applaud the House for standing firm and restoring the State Auditor’s funding.** The Auditor can continue investigating misuse of public funds. (Why would any politician scheme to block the Auditor from scrutinizing tax dollar spending? Did they really think they could do so and not look ridiculous? If Homer Simpson did political strategy, I doubt he’d make that mistake. It is political positioning 1.0.)

**Restraining public spending matters in Mississippi for several reasons.**

**First, all those efforts to pass a law to eliminate the state income tax over the coming year will amount to little unless we continue to maintain a budget surplus.** The budget passed will maintain a modest surplus and sets a precedent that puts us on the road to actual income tax elimination.

Second, if Mississippi’s economy keeps growing at a rate of 3-4 percent a year, and the budget only grows by 1-2 percent a year, the size of the private sector will grow relative to the overall economy. **This is the only way to lift Mississippi over the next generation from being one of the poorest states in the Union to being one of the richest.**

Perhaps the most significant thing about this year’s budget is not just that it is fiscally restrained. It was decided openly and transparently. **The days when billion-dollar decisions could be made by a handful of good ole boys at the Capitol in private are coming to an end.**

**_A new generation of leaders is emerging in our state who not only support pro-growth policies. They aren’t willing to keep doing politics like its 1960-something._**

Have a wonderful weekend!

body:
Normally when I write to you via email, I like them to be different from the other messages you get from most elected officials.
#

Peter -
Normally when you see my name in your inbox, I like the messages to be different from the other emails you get from most elected officials.
I've written to you in detail about the depth of corruption and self-enrichment of the Trump Administration, the President's thirst for political retribution and intimidation, along with other things I am seeing or working on in Washington, D.C. and at home in Georgia.
This message is different. It's more direct.
I am reaching out this morning with a last-ditch request for a contribution to my campaign before our May fundraising drive comes to a close at midnight. Here's why:
This race will be one of the most competitive and expensive in the nation. I am the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024 and that makes me MAGA’s #1 target.
In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history – and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.
Now we must win again. And we will win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please make a contribution to my re-election campaign today before our May fundraising drive comes to a close in just a few hours.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may25.ZUBy2n&refcode=em250531-1&t=1&akid=402%2E5691347%2EPgwNXL)

When I first heard that a book I wrote was one of hundreds banned from the U.S. Naval Academy library under the Trump regime, I found the news incredibly concerning.
You see, my book — _Our Time Is Now_ — chronicles the erosion of voting rights, highlights the far right’s attacks on democracy, and provides a blueprint for ending voter suppression and empowering our fellow citizens to uphold and expand free and fair elections.
And if the far right actually believes that my book about ensuring democracy is a threat to their ability to destroy it, then I’m on to something.
In addition, I’m proud to be in the company of authors like Dr. Carol Anderson, a renowned historian and professor of African American studies who serves on the Board of Directors for Fair Fight Action. Her book _White Rage: The Unspoken Truth Of Our Racial Divide_ was also banned. It won the National Book Critics Circle Award for criticism, and it analyzes the struggle for Black Americans to be full participants in our democracy.
Of course, the ultimate target of book bans like these is the power that we, the people, possess. The power that MAGA Republicans would suppress. The power that we must use.
**With our freedoms facing grave threats, and with people in power trying to keep us from understanding how to defend it, we must double down in our fight for democracy.**
**And we must support groups like Fair Fight that do the vital work of making our democracy live up to its promise, tackling the rise of authoritarianism, and ensuring free and fair elections.**
[**That’s why I need to ask if you can make a donation of any amount to Fair Fight. Let’s be clear: You ban books if you’re afraid of the knowledge they can provide and the questions they may inspire readers to ask.
And you suppress the vote if you’re afraid you could not win a truly fair election — or if you believe some people are inherently unworthy of participating in our democracy.
My book was banned alongside works of literature and scholarship by people like Maya Angelou and Ibram X. Kendi.
Mind you, they did not ban _Mein Kampf_ , by Adolf Hitler.
The targeted books are about topics like race, gender, and public policy, and they fall under MAGA’s attack on DEI — also known as “diversity, equity, and inclusion”; also known as the basis for all the movements of progress and opportunity we’ve achieved as a nation.
**Moves like these reveal the Trump regime’s outright contempt for civil rights and the ability of women, people of color, and marginalized communities to be part of American life. And as they continue working to suppress our voices, we must keep on fighting back.**
**I’m proud that Fair Fight stands strong against attacks on our democracy.**
I founded Fair Fight after the 2018 elections to help make sure every eligible voter can easily register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted. Since its founding, Fair Fight has successfully combated voter suppression, made it possible for more people to exercise their power and their voice at the ballot box, and helped elect pro-democracy champions from municipal governments to the U.S. Senate and the presidency.
Fair Fight will continue building pro-voter political power in the South, expanding access to voting, preventing mass voter purges, and pioneering strategic analysis and innovation to counter rising authoritarianism.

We are sounding the alarm. Last week, the primary elections in Pennsylvania took place. Now, all eyes are on the General Elections in November, including the judicial retention seats on the PA Supreme Court.

As a reminder, Democrats hold a five-to-two majority on the PA Supreme Court, but this year’s retention elections could swing the balance of power if the Democratically elected justices do not win their retention elections.

**As NPP CEO Kadida Kenner stated to _The Keystone_ , “This will be a historic election in Pennsylvania, and I’m sure we’re going to come close to Wisconsin’s $110 million when it comes down to it...These Supreme Court justice seats are so important because they’re ensuring our voting rights, our access to abortion and securing democracy in general.” **

This isn’t hyperbole: It is reported that Elon Musk has already spent a million on these races, and PA’s richest billionaire, Jeffrey Yass, is planning to spend even more in his anti-retention campaign against the justices elected as Democrats.

If MAGA is successful with their anti-retention campaign, the PA Supreme Court could have three vacancies until the Governor is able to appoint and confirm their replacements (unlikely as this would require support from Republicans in the PA Senate) or until the next judicial election in 2027. **Their ultimate goal: having a Republican majority on the PA Supreme Court before the 2028 presidential election.**

I hope you share that sentiment. And if you don't, then the rest of this message just isn't for you. Feel free to delete this email and move on with your life if you're not committed to American excellence.

**If you 're still reading, then I thank you for your commitment. And now, I'm counting on you to rise to the occasion, Peter. **

My Navy SEAL brother, Senior Chief Derrick Van Orden, needs your help. He served our nation for over 25 years in the Navy and fought extremists from the Taliban to Al-Qaeda. Dear friends,
I am reaching out to you today to respectfully ask if you can [**make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may25.7MLdP7&refcode=em250531-1-b&t=2&akid=10512%2E3935704%2EVaNcdD)
We knew that when Donald Trump was elected in November, there would be challenges ahead. And now, we are seeing firsthand that Donald Trump and the MAGA-right wasted no time in trying to reverse our hard-earned gun safety progress.
Some of the most extreme members of Congress have introduced bills pushing for the abolishment of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives, as well as advocating for national concealed carry reciprocity. President Trump even signed an executive order that serves as the first step in undoing the gun safety progress we made under President Biden and Vice President Harris’ tenure.
The challenges we’re up against won’t be easy. But I know a thing or two about getting through tough times.
I was shot in 2011, and I have been on a recovery journey every day since. Some days are harder than others, but even on the most difficult days, I refuse to give up hope. It’s the same way I refuse to give up hope for our gun violence prevention movement, even in these moments of uncertainty.
I will be fighting each and every day for a future free from gun violence, just as I have since GIFFORDS’ founding twelve years ago. Can I count on you to stand by me in this fight?

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. Here’s the truth, Peter: after the 2010 Census, Republicans were more strategic than Democrats about the long game of redistricting and what it could mean for their party’s dominance in state and federal elections. As a result, they won some big victories by manipulating maps to create an artificial advantage for themselves after the 2010 Census. To fight back, Attorney General Eric Holder and President Barack Obama launched the National Democratic Redistricting Committee (NDRC) — the first-ever strategic hub for redistricting, with a comprehensive plan to level the playing field by winning fair maps. With focused effort, we decreased the Republican structural advantage in the U.S. House from 23 seats in 2012, to 11 seats in 2020, to just three seats in 2022. And based on that proven model, we’ve built a 10 Year Plan to win fair maps in 2032 — positioning ourselves both on the front lines against short-term threats and moving forward strategically to end gerrymandering in the long term. subject: Why I’m endorsing Troy Jackson for Governor of Maine

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
When I think about the kind of leaders we need right now – the ones who don’t just talk about working-class struggles but live them – I think of Troy Jackson.
And I want you to be the first to know: Today, I’m proud to endorse Troy for Governor of Maine.
Troy’s not a typical politician or someone born into power. He’s a fifth-generation logger from the woods of Allagash who’s spent his life fighting for working people – not just with words, but with action.
He’s gone toe-to-toe with corporate lobbyists, stood up to Big Pharma, and never backed down from a fight if it meant helping the people he represents. Troy knows what it’s like to live paycheck to paycheck. He knows how it feels to be told that your voice doesn’t matter – and he’s spent his career proving that it does.
He’s building a campaign powered by ordinary folks – not special interests. That means no corporate PAC money. No billionaire backers calling the shots. Just people who believe Maine deserves a governor who will fight like hell for them.
If you’re reading this, I know that you’re here because this is the kind of politics you believe in – a mighty grassroots movement powered by everyday people. So I hope you’ll join me in supporting Troy today. Will you chip in $20 to my and Troy’s campaigns? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/troy-jackson-fundraising-split?refcode=20250531&amount=20]
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/troy-jackson-fundraising-split?refcode=20250531&amount=20]
DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/troy-jackson-fundraising-split?refcode=20250531]
This is our moment to show the strength of our collective voices. That someone from a small town, with calloused hands and a big heart can take on the establishment and win.
Let’s help Troy get there.
In solidarity,
Ro

name: David Hogg
subject: This is not a platitude, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Young people have one of the most valuable assets in politics.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250531-1&t=1&akid=2202%2E587540%2E1lZonw)
Peter,
When we say young people are the future, it’s not a platitude. **_It’s a strategy._**
**Time is one of the most valuable assets in politics – and young people have it.**
**Let’s be 100% clear:** We aren’t hitting the campaign trail and asking anyone to vote for our candidates just because they’re young. That would be dumb. 🙄
What we _are_ doing is asking people like you to make a long-term investment in the leaders who will carry the torch on gun violence prevention, action on climate change, abortion access, voting rights, and _every_ issue over the next 30+ years.
We know that these fights aren’t going away anytime soon. And if we want to win them, we need a bench of unapologetically progressive leaders for the long haul.
**We’re staring down the end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we are asking folks like you to join us by making an investment in the future of our country.**
**[Peter, can you rush a $5 contribution now before tonight’s deadline?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250531_1_eom?refcode=em20250531-2202&amount=5&refcode2=2202_587540_1lZonw&akid=2202%2E587540%2E1lZonw)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250531_1_eom?amount=5&refcode=em20250531-2202&refcode2=2202_587540_1lZonw&akid=2202%2E587540%2E1lZonw)**
Many of our most celebrated leaders were first elected by age 35:
🔵 Abraham Lincoln
🔵 Barack Obama
🔵 Stacey Abrams
🔵 John Lewis
🔵 John F. Kennedy
All of these leaders (and countless more) got their start in politics when they were young. **Just imagine the leaders of tomorrow that we’re electing together today.**
We don’t take corporate PAC money. Neither do our candidates. That means our work is **100% powered by grassroots donors like you** — and in many of these down-ballot races, we’re the biggest supporter these young candidates have.
But right now, we have a major fundraising deadline tonight at midnight, and we’re still short of where we need to be to ensure we can keep up the fight.
**[Peter, if you believe in our vision, contribute $5 now to help us reach our goal and power our work to elect a new generation of Democratic leaders.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250531_1_eom?refcode=em20250531-2202&amount=5&refcode2=2202_587540_1lZonw&akid=2202%2E587540%2E1lZonw)**
The leaders we elect today are the same ones who will be running for Senate and the White House in the years ahead. Let’s make sure they actually represent _us._
Thank you,
David Hogg

| Peter -- It's time for the newest installment of _**Control What You Can.**_ __**But first, a quick ask. We need resources to do the work that we do. We try not to act like the legacy parties and send out too many fundraising asks that make it seem as if the world is ending, but a generous donor has agreed to match all donations, including from merch purchases, from 12:01am ET Friday through Midnight ET on Sunday, up to $5,000! Now's the perfect time to chip in or buy some merch and have twice the impact.** [Make a Donation](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=friday_revenue_increase_foll&n=2) | [Buy Some Merch](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=97vo83vzLU7BnykmHxrcoyVf8w1UJZmos-tvIomylwM&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=friday_revenue_increase_foll&n=3) Speaking of raising revenue... Last week, we asked you what was more important for tackling the national debt: increasing revenue, or decreasing spending. Almost everyone believed that both options need to be on the table, but how much raising vs. cutting the government should do was a point of debate! Since there was such strong support for both options, we wanted to follow up and dig in a bit. So we're going to spend the next two weeks tackling each of those sides. This week? **Revenue generation**. Where do you think the most fruitful area is for the government to increase revenues? [Answer on our website:](https://home.forwardparty.com/increase_tax_revenue_feedback?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=friday_revenue_increase_foll&n=4) [](https://home.forwardparty.com/increase_tax_revenue_feedback?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=friday_revenue_increase_foll&n=5) [Or on X:](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=mhUdGCm_eEqxEEjcw0-lGbIN6AZpbu4iFxE-qCh2CjGG56VZxOpuaA0WEoCZ6rxmz9injlrfHVICEPUT-rNmJw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=friday_revenue_increase_foll&n=6) [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=mhUdGCm_eEqxEEjcw0-lGbIN6AZpbu4iFxE-qCh2CjGG56VZxOpuaA0WEoCZ6rxmz9injlrfHVICEPUT-rNmJw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=friday_revenue_increase_foll&n=7) Once you've answered the poll, please leave a comment and tell us why you selected the answer you did. Friends, family, longtime supporters, and new team members,
As we approach a half-year of Donald Trump’s second term, I want to thank you for your ongoing support. I remain determined to work as hard as I can every single day in the Senate on behalf of Virginians and all Americans.
As I have said of this Administration before, our goal must always be to advance everywhere we can and defend everything we must. These first few months have required rigorous defense — and while we haven’t won every fight, we have made real progress in pushing back against the worst of this Administration’s and this President’s impulses and actions.
The fight continues — particularly here in Virginia, where we will soon enter a general election that represents the first major electoral opportunity to rebuke Donald Trump and the GOP.
As we close out the month of May and prepare for a big June, I’m asking for your help. Will you make a contribution of any amount to my Common Ground PAC to help fund the fight both nationally and in VA?
You can chip in via this secure link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
I sincerely appreciate your support, whether it’s through donating when you can, sharing your advice and feedback, or simply reading these emails and staying in touch.
Thank you for everything. More to come soon.
-Tim Kaine

We know the SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before the next election, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
If you missed it: This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

In a moment, I’m going to ask you to[make a donation to support the critical work we’re doing at JanePAC before our end-of-month fundraising deadline at midnight.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108729687/548826083/2105508926?refcode=ea.fcb2936e-343e-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ms=ea.fcb2936e-343e-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZjYjI5MzZlLTM0M2UtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ocQy0gJ_j1lqehJymK_YY7m8QaANW61DQbRq0vmoxzI=) But first, let me explain.** I turned 87 this past December. People ask me when I plan to slow down. The truth is, I can’t imagine doing anything else. When you know the stakes, stepping away just isn’t an option. Not when everything — and I mean _everything_ — is on the line for our planet. Over the years, I’ve thrown myself into this work with everything I have. Sometimes that means marching in the streets or getting arrested for civil disobedience. Other times, it meant sitting across from elected officials and telling them the blunt truth, whether they wanted to hear it or not. **Each of those moments shaped me. But they’ve also taught me that protest alone isn’t enough to shift the course we’re on. We need people in power who are willing to act.** That’s why I started JanePAC. I wanted to help elect leaders who aren’t beholden to fossil fuel executives. People with the courage to do what’s right — not just what’s easy. And right now, the clock is ticking faster than ever. The Trump administration has been relentless. Every week, there’s a new rollback or giveaway to Big Oil, a new assault on communities that are already fighting to survive. It’s hard to keep up, and even harder to accept that this is happening while so many of our institutions remain silent. That silence is what we’re working to break. We’re supporting candidates across the country who are stepping up where the federal government has failed and bringing climate justice into city halls, school boards, statehouses, and beyond. **One of the biggest fights this year is in Virginia, where every seat in the House of Delegates is on the ballot this November — and where JanePAC has proudly endorsed 11 climate champions ready to meet the moment.** We helped flip the Virginia House in 2023, and now Republicans are doing everything they can to take it back. It’s a fight we can’t lose. And it’s one of many reasons why I’m not slowing down. **JanePAC is organizing in key districts, lifting up bold climate candidates, and building the kind of grassroots momentum that can withstand anything the fossil fuel lobby throws at us.[So if you've been waiting for the perfect time to chip in, then this is YOUR moment. clean_body: We need bold leadership now more than ever. | = Hi there, it’s Jane. In a moment, I’m going to ask you to= But first, let me explain. I turned 87 this past December. People ask me when I plan to slow down. The truth is, I can’t imagine doing anything else. When you know the stakes, stepping away just isn’t an option. Not when everything — and I mean everything — is on the line for our planet. Over the years, I’ve thrown myself into this work with everything I have. Sometimes that means marching in the streets or getting arrested for civil disobedience. Other times, it meant sitting across from elected officials and telling them the blunt truth, whether they wanted to hear it or not. Each of those moments shaped me. But they’ve also taught me that protest alone isn’t enough to shift the course we’re on. We need people in power who are willing to act. That’s why I started JanePAC. I wanted to help elect leaders who aren’t beholden to fossil fuel executives. People with the courage to do what’s right — not just what’s easy. And right now, the clock is ticking faster than ever. The Trump administration has been relentless. Every week, there’s a new rollback or giveaway to Big Oil, a new assault on communities that are already fighting to survive. It’s hard to keep up, and even harder to accept that this is happening while so many of our institutions remain silent. That silence is what we’re working to break. We’re supporting candidates across the country who are stepping up where the federal government has failed and bringing climate justice into city halls, school boards, statehouses, and beyond. One of the biggest fights this year is in Virginia, where every seat in the House of Delegates is on the ballot this November — and where JanePAC has proudly endorsed 11 climate champions ready to meet the moment. We helped flip the Virginia House in 2023, and now Republicans are doing everything they can to take it back. It’s a fight we can’t lose. And it’s one of many reasons why I’m not slowing down. body:
All I’ve ever wanted to do in life was serve my country. I did it in the Navy and at NASA. I ran for the Senate and won so that I could keep serving.
#

Believe it or not, we’re only four months into Trump’s presidency. I don’t blame you if your head is spinning — he’s done a ton of damage already.
But for each of those four months, we’ve been out front. Fighting back.
[**And before our end-of-month deadline at midnight tonight, I’m humbly asking you to make a donation to help us keep it up.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may25/.03Y6gu&refcode=em250531-1-550&t=1&akid=6079%2E6688874%2ERZ5Lhu)
**[DONATE](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may25/.03Y6gu&refcode=em250531-1-550&t=2&akid=6079%2E6688874%2ERZ5Lhu)**
Let me explain why this is so important, especially now.
Since January, I’ve had Elon Musk call me a traitor to my own country on two separate occasions.
I’ve had one of Trump’s top operatives, Roger Stone, call for me to be tried for treason and executed. And then he spent thousands of dollars online attacking me, spreading those threats.
All I’ve ever wanted to do in life was serve my country. I did it in the Navy and at NASA. I ran for the Senate so I could keep serving. I’ve fought to defend our Constitution, voting rights, the right to choose, for good infrastructure, and for health care and services people can afford.
I defended our country in the Navy, and in the Senate I’ve worked to support our democratic allies — particularly Ukraine in their fight against Russian aggression.
But, I don’t see eye-to-eye with Trump. And for that, they call me a traitor. Trump, his cronies, and his millions of supporters have been attacking me relentlessly. With Trump, Musk, Stone, and the whole MAGA Right lining up against me, I’m going to need a big team behind me.
That’s why your donation is so important, and it’s why I’m hoping you’ll chip in before midnight tonight.
**[Can I count on you? Use this link and make a donation so I can continue the fight against Trump from the frontlines. It’d mean a lot to me, personally.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may25/.03Y6gu&refcode=em250531-1-550&t=3&akid=6079%2E6688874%2ERZ5Lhu)

## **FINAL HOURS: Help Power Our Emergency Campaign to Oppose MAGA Billionaire Tax Scam**
**The Goal:** $30,000
**The Deadline:** MIDNIGHT
**The Fight:** Stop Trump’s and Congressional Republicans’ unprecedented attack on the environment.
**Your Contribution:**[**PENDING >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.) [**Renew your LCV membership before midnight to power our campaign against the most anti-environment budget bill in U.S. history >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_)
---
| | Peter — today is the final day of our emergency campaign to amp up our fight against the most anti-environment billionaire tax scam in history before it heads to the Senate floor this summer.
---
| | **This bill is NOT yet law, and Republicans have a razor-thin majority to pass it in the Senate — we can STILL take down the worst provisions.**
---
| | Our movement is gearing up to flood every senator’s inbox and voicemail with messages from constituents, and show up at town halls across the country, to oppose Republicans’ dirty energy agenda. Together, we can prevent their worst anti-environmental attacks from becoming law. But we rely on supporters like you to power our efforts.
---

---
| | But the difference between this bill becoming law and it being sent back to the negotiating table is _four votes_. We have a real opportunity to block the worst anti-environmental attacks in the Senate, but only if our movement is united and SHOWS UP. [**_Please, renew your membership to power our campaign to demand that the Senate prioritize our health, safety, and communities >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)

League of Conservation Voters

body:

Whether it’s _securing the border_ , _defunding the ploys put in place by the Biden regime_ ,_or stopping the endless spending that’s bankrupting our country_... **The time to act is right now.**
**I’m your voice in Congress every single day demanding the change that the American people demanded in November.**
And I’m not going to stop. Not for one second. Because you didn’t send me here to play games: you sent me here to fight!
But I need to know that you’re still standing with me against the slings and arrows of the Deep State, and whatever elements of the weaponized federal government are still in place.

There is still so much of the Trump Agenda that we need to pass, and I am going up against every ally of the Swamp that wants to stall our progress.
**Your support gives me the strength and resources to keep going: louder, harder, and without apology.**
**_[Please rush a contribution today and let the Swamp know that we’re not backing down](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/azj3/?__vbtrk=MjkzNzE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzNzE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**

Every moment matters so I hope that you’ll chip in as soon as possible if you are able to stand with me today. With your support the radical Left will be unable to slow down our America First movement.
| | _For America,_

But to get there, she needs our support.
Will you join me in standing with Jena by making a contribution today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2505-q2-jg-eom?refcode=250531-email-gail]

Gail Schoettler
Former Colorado Lieutenant Governor

Hi Peter, I hope this note finds you well. Your support means the world to me, and I never take it for granted. I wanted to reach out to share what I’ve been up to this month. I’ll be honest, it’s been a busy few weeks in Congress. My team and I have been working around the clock and staying focused on what matters most: delivering for our communities. I introduced the _HAVEN Act_ , which would help ensure every American has access to safe, affordable, and dignified housing. I spoke out in the Natural Resources Committee against Republican members who continue to take money from Big Oil while blocking climate action. And I’ve been using my voice to defend constitutional rights and due process, including by calling for the safe return of Kilmar Abrego Garcia. I’m proud of the work I’ve done this month. It reflects the values I brought with me to Washington and the commitment I’ve made to the people of Arizona. But I also know that so many challenges lie ahead. We’re working to flip the House and ensure real leadership — not performative politics or corporate greed — guides our future. But taking back the House and electing Democratic champions nationwide is going to take major resources and support from this grassroots team. name: Meagan Hatcher-Mays, United for Democracy
subject: SCOTUS quietly blessed Trump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
The shady MAGA Supreme Court is using “the shadow docket” to enable Trump without real transparency or deliberation. | |
---
Peter, **Supreme Court opinions are released in June with much fanfare—but the Court has ways to overturn precedent**** _without_****all of the hoopla. And they just used it to quietly bless Trump’s ruthless gutting of federal agencies.** **Have you ever heard of the Shadow Docket?** It’s a term for when the Supreme Court deals with emergency requests and other matters that aren’t part of its scheduled proceedings—often without full briefing, oral argument, or a written opinion. It was originally conceived as a way to make minor clarifications or to deal with emergencies quickly. **But recently, the Roberts Court has leaned on the Shadow Docket to overturn precedent without making the front page of the New York Times.** Just last week, MAGA justices issued a shadow docket ruling that allowed Trump to fire leadership at the National Labor Relations Board and Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, seemingly in contravention of the laws establishing the agencies. The cases are pending, but the Supreme Court went ahead and approved the firings without a full hearing. **It’s outrageous that the Supreme Court can quietly bless Trump’s worst impulses without going through a full judicial process. And it’s dangerous for our democracy that this has become the norm.** [**America will not be ruled from the shadows by nine justices in robes. Congress must step in now and stop this dangerous use of the shadow docket. Add your name to tell Congress: Put limits on the shadow docket now!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38jvf5GaclcQ7i_R9B-DMhJMqTEqO2yNGiTAFBA6ApJQAp3sYTm5LBhyyHkVCU9WHHhNRmPD9vtUtaFB1Ww5rHX51joNnZqLkR-c1WP9UFqVevFAQRuUzt3BDhsp5zuodMmi93NvLLdF7sDS_WjhUJBRCjVKuFFYrPYNd6kqogSwZh7vBP5GpgvldnGNXpob15a222kQB2PzKg9GG6A-ZQ7egGYpTHhdAugQrWwXqreIoI7pW6T10GvW5SltyUpwaHeimvRETdk7qm0dhgFKpsbHFdkKhrXQicjtKx2zZpLOPbSMSmNvZKLyJ5HwryGGm9WPsvxApsRv4jASohCB6OT/4gy/m84Dhg9BQFiqHydTbgauSA/h0/h001.9a_6W0bL3MNprLHVUpIekdXhEAxb-7DPLyedSLg4V_I) [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38jvf5GaclcQ7i_R9B-DMhJMqTEqO2yNGiTAFBA6ApJQAp3sYTm5LBhyyHkVCU9WHHhNRmPD9vtUtaFB1Ww5rHX51joNnZqLkR-c1WP9UFqVWAMwt5SlzAS1bM-cAgRKUUuKafErPGBtIL2V9clnh9HosswpK8d5OIiU8ni4TJMIF4vO5MdGvjXuOIuZ2Sa0wbihJDZWn1FD255auvtd1gG7hIT52gkL7JauS0xpr8ROoSI1RCbm0d0Bbsdpo7NK9BEcdT-XznKg2qmxf82NW9XOGMHhwyGYKNjFDBL0h9STKc75rRR121tm0Nm3aENWYk0aLAYxtpiz8JZ8DOHDS5H/4gy/m84Dhg9BQFiqHydTbgauSA/h1/h001.Mygd5xwEMx10INuvbKxigO78yot9WeQtQL2lsapad8g) Justice Kagan’s angry dissent rightly called the Court out for overturning 90 years of shadow docket precedent to support Trump’s authoritarian actions. **She’s right—the MAGA justices are allowing Trump to break the law without waiting for the Supreme Court to rule on his case.** Last week’s shadow docket ruling gives Trump permission to fire workers in independent agencies at will, even when the written statutes say they can only be fired for cause. Is it any surprise that the Roberts Court is siding with Trump against the NLRB and CFPB, both of which exist to help workers and consumers stand up to corporate greed? **These agencies are extremely popular with the American people, and there is no legal basis for Trump’s gutting of them. If the Supreme Court can casually allow this authoritarian lawbreaking on a shadow docket, what else will they overturn without a full judicial proceeding?** **This is why we have checks and balances. clean_body: The shady MAGA Supreme Court is using “the shadow docket” to enable Trump without real transparency or deliberation. | | Peter, Supreme Court opinions are released in June with much fanfare—but the Court has ways to overturn precedent withoutall of the hoopla. And they just used it to quietly bless Trump’s ruthless gutting of federal agencies. Have you ever heard of the Shadow Docket? It’s a term for when the Supreme Court deals with emergency requests and other matters that aren’t part of its scheduled proceedings—often without full briefing, oral argument, or a written opinion. It was originally conceived as a way to make minor clarifications or to deal with emergencies quickly. But recently, the Roberts Court has leaned on the Shadow Docket to overturn precedent without making the front page of the New York Times. Just last week, MAGA justices issued a shadow docket ruling that allowed Trump to fire leadership at the National Labor Relations Board and Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, seemingly in contravention of the laws establishing the agencies. The cases are pending, but the Supreme Court went ahead and approved the firings without a full hearing. It’s outrageous that the Supreme Court can quietly bless Trump’s worst impulses without going through a full judicial process. And it’s dangerous for our democracy that this has become the norm. Justice Kagan’s angry dissent rightly called the Court out for overturning 90 years of shadow docket precedent to support Trump’s authoritarian actions. She’s right—the MAGA justices are allowing Trump to break the law without waiting for the Supreme Court to rule on his case. Last week’s shadow docket ruling gives Trump permission to fire workers in independent agencies at will, even when the written statutes say they can only be fired for cause. Is it any surprise that the Roberts Court is siding with Trump against the NLRB and CFPB, both of which exist to help workers and consumers stand up to corporate greed? These agencies are extremely popular with the American people, and there is no legal basis for Trump’s gutting of them. If the Supreme Court can casually allow this authoritarian lawbreaking on a shadow docket, what else will they overturn without a full judicial proceeding? This is why we have checks and balances. Driving tests are no different, and as the Democrats have imported the third world into our nation, we have also imported them onto our roads, and guilty liberals go out of their way to get them drivers licenses (so they can vote, but one thing at a time...).
And we are all at risk.
Recently **[a viral video](https://substack.com/redirect/f542119d-1c95-48f9-8762-629b0b659890?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** showed a driver in Ohio come to a complete stop on the interstate because he missed the exit causing a multi-car accident. The identity of the driver has yet to be announced (odd because the car's make and model and license are clearly visible and traceable...) but we can all agree this person should never, drive again. Ever. This person is a danger to the rest of us.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..OfKBS8ksRRexd-G3qiEdWAJcoe-okGRDmsvZdto5GDo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=164880944)
If states are going to water down driving exams to get illegals into the system, then the federal government must step in. Maryland drivers don't stay in Maryland, as anyone in DC or Virginia knows, and something about the interstate commerce clause and the role of Congress. We need to make the driving exam very difficult. Very difficult. There should be a year of probation, and I would mandate a "Probationary Driver" flag attached to their car like those reindeer antlers people attach to their car windows at Christmas. Announce the newbie.
Regardless of the plan driving is not a right, and the current lax exams are putting the rest of us, and our insurance premiums, in jeopardy.
### Two: Dot XXX
Porn is uncomfortable to talk about, so let's do it.
I am the last of the generation that had analogue porn (VHS and magazines) and saw the start and ubiquity of digital porn era. There is no doubt that the ease of access to porn is bad for children: it skews their ideas of sex and sexuality, it makes it harder for them to have meaningful relationships, leads to social isolation, the rise of the INCELS, and is emotionally and psychologically damaging.
The advantage of the old day was that porn carried with it an intrinsic sense of taboo. It was sneaked, discussed in whispers, hid it from their parents, and snickered in private. Kids even too young to have it knew they were too young, knew what they had was not "good", and knew to view it with a healthy sense of discretion and even shame, and that made for better kids.
Clicking onto porn sites should not be as easy as clicking onto games, and the normalization of what is not normal (porn is not normal sex, don't pretend otherwise) is destroying their little minds.
One stat claims **[1.2 million American girls](https://substack.com/redirect/60980e27-9427-46cb-ad0c-f41988a94ef5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** are on OnlyFans. That is not healthy and not good. Yes, it is legal, and I'm not trying to make it illegal. I am trying to protect kids and protect those who don't want it infiltrating their phones and computers.
My proposal is simple. Internet porn sites must migrate to a .xxx url. Not dot com. Not dot net. DOT XXX. And with that simple law, moms and dad, schools and libraries, can block access to minors.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..OfKBS8ksRRexd-G3qiEdWAJcoe-okGRDmsvZdto5GDo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=164880944)
Don't talk to me about researching breast cancer. I know this stupid game and I'm not playing. "Young people interested in medicine will be unable to study advances made in OBGYN fields". F-Off. You're deceitful.
Now come the annoying libertarians: how do you define porn? "Ummm, aksually, I saw a Bernini sculpture and I was offended by the nudity, is that porn?"
Let's make it simple: The Motion Picture Association of America gives every movie a rating: G, R, NC-17, etc. if the MPAA knows how to define it, why can't the internet? Let's use their rules. Your IMAX showing the latest marvel movie in theater 7 is not showing porn in theater 8.
The local video store knew which videos had to go in the back room behind the curtain... why can't the internet do the same? Your newsstand vendor knows which magazines could not be displayed, why can't the internet do the same?
I'm not trying to stop your porn, but I am trying to stop children from being irreparably corrupted because weak men are afraid to put up safeguards.
Of course, kids will try to find a way around it. Boys will always be boys, even in the digital age. But if you upload porn to a dot com or a dot net, then the punishment will be insanely harsh for the company and the website managers. The burden will be on the companies, not the consumers. If Coke can't put cocaine in their cola, then a company can't put... you get the idea.
As for foreign website companies operating in the Caymen's or Canada to thwart American law? Easy. We shut them down.
We have an obligation to protect our children before they become perverted adults with power, a society of Jeffrey Epsteins and Hunter Bidens. This one is easy, necessary, and clutch if we really want to win the war against our children and restore some decency back into society.
That's two winners. I got eight more to go.
We keep fighting. Honor and courage.

Friend, Today is a National Day of Action for Single Payer Healthcare for All (also known as expanded Medicare for All). In my district, my team is supporting a prayer service and rally for people who’ve been killed and harmed by our for-profit medical system. People are demanding a system that puts people before profit, where healthcare is treated as the human right that it is. They’re demanding**** a publicly financed, national single payer program that would provide comprehensive coverage to everyone—and an end to medical debt. With increasing attacks on healthcare access, activists are raising the alarm to not only protect our current coverage, but radically transform and improve it. I’m supporting Medicare for All legislation in Congress, but we need to get more members of Congress on board and prioritize this urgent issue. You can also check out below for how to find in-person actions happening near you today. We know the vast majority of Americans support Medicare for All—even a majority of Republicans.
Our profit-driven healthcare system is killing us while enriching Big Pharma and health insurance CEOs. As more and more families struggle to pay bills and meet their needs, these companies are profiting off our pain. We urgently need to take the profit motive out of healthcare by passing improved and expanded Medicare for All.
The grassroots group National Single Payer explains: _“A study published in 2021 in the Lancet found that a single payer financing system under Medicare for All would eliminate the high administrative costs of private insurance billing, marketing, and CEO salaries resulting in estimated administrative savings of $225 billion annually. The study also found that a single payer system would create efficiencies from negotiated drug prices and save over 68,000 lives every year.”_
The lack of health insurance leads to thousands of preventable deaths each year—just because people can’t afford the care they need to survive. If Republicans' budget bill passes, millions will be kicked off their health insurance and more people will die. **No one should have to die because they can’t afford care.**
**No family should ever face financial ruin because they got sick.****** But 90% of bankruptcies are due to extreme medical debt, and**** nearly 1 in 5 U.S. adults have medical debt on their credit reports, which means they may be denied housing, employment, transportation, or other necessities because of a sudden health crisis or visit to the emergency room.
So I’ve passed policy and worked with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to take medical debt off people’s credit reports. Now I’m fighting to protect this progress from Trump’s attacks. And I’m continuing to fight for expanded Medicare for All, which would improve the successful and beloved government-run program for seniors to cover all U.S. residents and take care of people’s needs like dental and vision care and more.
**As Trump and Republicans in Congress try to kick millions of Americans off public health insurance, we need to not only defend our current system but also demand real change so that**** _everyone_****can access quality healthcare.**

clean_body: People are demanding a system that puts people before profit. | | | Friend, Today is a National Day of Action for Single Payer Healthcare for All (also known as expanded Medicare for All). In my district, my team is supporting a prayer service and rally for people who’ve been killed and harmed by our for-profit medical system. People are demanding a system that puts people before profit, where healthcare is treated as the human right that it is. They’re demanding** a publicly financed, national single payer program that would provide comprehensive coverage to everyone—and an end to medical debt. With increasing attacks on healthcare access, activists are raising the alarm to not only protect our current coverage, but radically transform and improve it. I’m supporting Medicare for All legislation in Congress, but we need to get more members of Congress on board and prioritize this urgent issue. | You can also check out below for how to find in-person actions happening near you today. We know the vast majority of Americans support Medicare for All—even a majority of Republicans. Our profit-driven healthcare system is killing us while enriching Big Pharma and health insurance CEOs. As more and more families struggle to pay bills and meet their needs, these companies are profiting off our pain. We urgently need to take the profit motive out of healthcare by passing improved and expanded Medicare for All. The grassroots group National Single Payer explains: “A study published in 2021 in the Lancet found that a single payer financing system under Medicare for All would eliminate the high administrative costs of private insurance billing, marketing, and CEO salaries resulting in estimated administrative savings of $225 billion annually. The study also found that a single payer system would create efficiencies from negotiated drug prices and save over 68,000 lives every year.” The lack of health insurance leads to thousands of preventable deaths each year—just because people can’t afford the care they need to survive. If Republicans' budget bill passes, millions will be kicked off their health insurance and more people will die. No one should have to die because they can’t afford care. No family should ever face financial ruin because they got sick.**** But 90% of bankruptcies are due to extreme medical debt, and nearly 1 in 5 U.S. adults have medical debt on their credit reports, which means they may be denied housing, employment, transportation, or other necessities because of a sudden health crisis or visit to the emergency room. So I’ve passed policy and worked with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to take medical debt off people’s credit reports. Now I’m fighting to protect this progress from Trump’s attacks. And I’m continuing to fight for expanded Medicare for All, which would improve the successful and beloved government-run program for seniors to cover all U.S. residents and take care of people’s needs like dental and vision care and more. As Trump and Republicans in Congress try to kick millions of Americans off public health insurance, we need to not only defend our current system but also demand real change so that** everyonecan access quality healthcare. Thank you for taking action today! Here you can also find actions happening around the country today: . In solidarity, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . Peter,

president and his family have monetized the White House more than any

blowback and official investigations."

services and monetizing public office. But Our Squad is standing strong,
fighting to protect what belongs to the people.

Hi friends,
I want to be transparent with you about something that actually matters a lot, but that I’ve put on the back burner these last few months – fundraising for 2026.
I’ll admit it’s been difficult to think about everything that goes into winning in 2026 when our democracy and institutions are under constant attack right now . While I’ve been doing everything I can to fight back and defend our democracy (more on that below), I can’t ignore the fact that fundraising does matter and does have a direct impact on whether we win or lose next November.
So as we close out the month and enter the homestretch of Q2, will you chip in a few dollars to help me take on House Republicans and build up our resources for the fight ahead? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Over the past four months, I’ve been focused on fighting back against Trump’s lawless, immoral actions and the Republicans who are facilitating (and speeding up!) our country’s destruction.
I’ve hosted town halls to hear directly from my constituents about their concerns and the ways this administration is impacting them (thank you to so many of you for attending!), and I hosted a “Know Your Rights” training for anyone concerned about interactions with ICE and federal law enforcement.
I’ve introduced legislation like the Delete DOGE Act to stop DOGE from slashing and burning our government, the IVF for Military Families Act , which would require IVF treatment to be covered for service members and their families, and the Protect U.S. National Security Act to prevent government funds from being used to eliminate USAID.
And I’m not stopping anytime soon.
But I *am* asking for your help to make sure all my focus can remain on this work instead of raising money.
Will you chip in online to help make sure we’re ready to take back the House in 2026? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Thank you so much for anything you can give. It means a lot to me to know that I’m in this fight with such a strong team of supporters!
-Sara

I believe that this race is similar to the ones I’ve completed on foot. They require strength, endurance, and grit to get past mile 20. But I know that together, **we will win this race and deliver a bright future for New Mexicans across our beautiful state.**

Team, let's do some quick math: **Republicans + Trump’s agenda = richer billionaires and more Americans struggling to get by.** We believe in showing our work, so here’s how we got to our answer.

House Republicans passed their cruel and devastating budget bill in the middle of the night while most Americans were asleep — because it’s _that_ unpopular.

This bill threatens the health care of millions of Americans while cutting taxes for the wealthiest individuals in the country. **It passed by a margin of just one vote.**

* Undo Trump's economic damage and put working families first
* Defend democracy by exposing corruption and expanding access to the ballot

body:
By raging at the judges he appointed himself, Trump is admitting the quiet part out loud - he doesn’t expect the judges he appoints to uphold the constitution or rule of law, he expects them to be obedient puppets that rubber stamp his agenda, unconstitutional or not. | | [ ](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv1STuy_axapI11rAiEMjCBP8MqJU5OU8RUGh4w-siT-15ich5zEUa_jQeMymSEGFdX2B4q7zYqINPz1eJixrCCiTlAW3TsaMeMtJKcOoqBy4TG_LsejZWQKnWza_myUvU-I2ZyI6c53H6Cb6PRT9brsD9O4SN6BegaSuKmkzZI9_axng8h6BGeJ5_lQEnhBgT9DVQ6c0gKmKqGwjsiL5BQsigIPFN49YHkshdk9wYUcj-Rify5wH0r7wG3lasrSFFsTJ4ccjMqU3SV6d9jEpJEAxlDlpgzNPhmPnMvFxhZFv6pxaApAvaagUQFOKL96M0W044cTgFPhCss8Y-uyC60wNGQAQvrABSKN7XX1j6-7LXa2CnjiDBZFf0Rjjs6URo/4gy/hhrxogznSyCgabgeKv-VNA/h0/h001.rcXiSu1IdSQEEdJXxXwePpujhSUGGT4cRspTGXpVKJ4)
---
Peter, Earlier this week, when federal judges blocked Trump's tariffs, Defend Our Courts issued a warning: **the decision will only embolden Trump 's war on courts.** And that is exactly what happened, _this time expanding his attacks to the judges he appointed himself:_
---
| [ ](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv1STuy_axapI11rAiEMjCBP8MqJU5OU8RUGh4w-siT-15ich5zEUa_jQeMymSEGFdO47ZpdvSqGujKQub0EVwio4To5_KUIlpNnoQ34DRWS0XoVloc2sWKSR5YJis1sumIKfgFIwBozzHJcCC6ubtaai_RkStoWR2ySBKLKnKUcNJQkux0d2M0HzXv4_kOknpRUR9BvXVdN1lWsSyYV96PX0wMYvLDw6715OGvzxL-hqcn1H-3EyuwoLMov94koX9mQFP1HUduQkaOW4m0PNQb4BlzlcZ2WTG78lz7zYrp-99tqaw8QtGDitBgJW24P5OJqWCaO3Ad-23M2GMBkH0f6z2YrxWl7VtkYwl4iIcK02DxS2nv7BJe7-20wEBqWsI/4gy/hhrxogznSyCgabgeKv-VNA/h1/h001.5l4qdA0-JfpmIsTfZMXxga07ZhfHC4_dIP6w6W74XRQ)

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/OaSyjK1tUpzd0eyjFZ8Rbe728fpdfV8pLPYGYM8RCL5epA39FmkYJzL5J4-UpViz-x3nSjtIULFPg1iWSK6LJCLvWfmYAFhldCWvxN0vabT26Li1iyk33mPkY9F-mIvIHwAdr1tvSuTKMPqTnTup5X1HCefV_WEMyEdboWT8uzIuv6XgXa8nSEFlUPvh14qJ4flat2tBoVIbOh5nqYITg9x4IdukXCRE0Oy9pC87uBWyXcB-HicQZ61bKQEtRoxYOPexUojND5dBPu_zccawTRm98tNHLKd3psZK23aRZQ3pj9sBEC56NVy_DCuXtZ5GFJO1ZcyQeZ0881fJtmureCmqisb_4zJ-4uXxhBFx2SjScw5TBx4hr8jKuJvFw1soVJrBYFoQgakNnSCC2Wyz3GhFj8xykEkhoyqWvcEHnLEaXM5MLRHfFdzurJ2ed5zA1Q/wSxR9FdYXFC1caNN7wvkvgoSErxakOmD/9) [NO](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/WcEes9rV_mumItkJOVz2KpwjjCx3pA0KAwWqT61KkNFcaF2WdhG7ZibDfCqkHF9uvajKbANcxO1qqsbZO7mHBt6RDp_zvtM1J15ifflyYNSSB0OYI7Flvq-Kz0kQ-jXINJvv6FdftA4s2mPrZyd_hQ_5vNDbYGoSEEFsGelNXkVgE3kBD9BxF3rCZGpf99aoDFLJbLEN7Ry1NPTgJiD1pNWKnfGrwn3MEc_ZDPVb_5ud0U2ArZk1hm66749_koeaNFdgf6h1LcqDmEAJLqoszqZTujA6LHpgYC4EYQXZvqc8J3uPIya8QoxJp_eBR1Bit8R94RlCpxo2xwCh8jAireQhTZXY5Z-v05S4mkVYpSzrehvHYe-OWdLPAPC8c4IXmLP_fBP_WGg7v4PyUL7UjVX57IGcYRzCZy1xPZS31q7IWn2dUYjVlonWaXaaA3fVew/jQRAujyq95ASR1VUsMubnxp2Slx6Y2ci/9) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://info.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/__HFDGZTHfYKYHXO7UxQ5dDgE2FtAAAh_Iu0mbzZjQU--bseLieeSfWvyo_FsGX54tX4Cjjmb9FTFEMz1YmIWwwM258dCuzGcn8cCWgS86jG4hBjIAw2GyopB1PNIlfAyAnPOoAOT4DwOuCdc09wjssnKLI8pnxphBpQKIOajDsM8bQg1oQ05TK5UZ2dPB9Kd_PRNQ109d2Xn2V0q3D3YRZ5b8v4oGXxvDgNh_z1fjwet24d3TAomSVUKpNlXNW3ixIKQePVJQpbrT59A3N3PTv_YlhgysILf1sVJiUiXSMCBpO3CYoNartGM5jiYIardRJosa9NbqFS-GSjBC86oWzvjL9V6PxxQccJR9T0FUwMLOwXRUL8_j0zL4ZDfh8uYZ_b0PiJh83kccVq6ww7yeAYOfe7j5zfsCWGsAgRY0_mywuB9zpNnm6g3DvWuqAdgw/lPNFNEz6BSa5uJ0InAdUl-i4rDV6L0Zg/9)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/tuzwH6aQ_4gvKsUpWgyqC1JnnBq2rxGfUtF3FSw_9V56OZ4RBrgsA-6ij-Pw-gNtmNlnMFOnX9Cb2X9V6oE0t0_v7QFhfL0EKSRfcFqSR5pEoi9rUMzRbRoRfeIDPfjCfFaOkD4uAeQrfnFeiAkMFp8dmOQNaSJFyqnlpKPpoJnGqB6T3XKIXQJ6DaiPoKIjXM-9R8n-vwFWfHV2hlSSh-TZTAew_h9gaoRLkUyefujQFLDUBnP0LLT_zC1pp4PBAEIuMkHlo9avf-lpWjMI0_isaIsk4brfEXkQY_d5l7Ss4W-YtB0w0idsxgO4gZI1Ly92RUGAHkYbMSsAiYQI96vwF9nGtvav9DTMEm7qTonKocjVONjs6gnHkHG_CwaTa2dhm6agNjKdzNZGzu86sULRmCJWaEmKC9KETVB7lDmRHojdDezn3UAl0Hc1WSQnpg/PKhOCTWcI94FmdxS5OXY-2pOZ0qSxsKA/9)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

subject: I step up and I get to work

body:
Peter, when I see a problem, I don't pass the buck. _I step up and I get to work._
My name is Abigail Spanberger. In 2018, I ran for Congress after Donald Trump and my Republican representative attempted to repeal the Affordable Care Act. Now, as I run for Governor of Virginia, Republicans' budget bill puts Medicaid on the chopping block.

subject: Your SCOTUS opinion needed
body:
Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Unsubscribe
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj2051vxogydgum61o3hv84gyral4jkqq59z9il30n01b5ec0l2hy1qaa3ggu1eg4ga177mzr73lnjvinb0fm&__stmp=sx522j&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx522j&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jehmb90uy96n8xfsa8m70afv3pq2v2bq09im5669ex5i9obpr2d6l1igojyu9er6u69mux1zo45zguv7pl4jl2wdsfn7idcqpykz0gb71l7c0pgd36lgyqmsg4yhifrpxhs5g3lyly41dx8gj65e&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx522j&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx522j&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx522j&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx522j&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jehmb90uy96n8xfsa8m70afvp0sucgz8e73bgovikjdd3zrn5mqp5xpovsc7cpg8q3nyv4tuqdll6y92748fxagu5c46fc1qmpfthobfqr98nnvk543t9picv1ifpykjk55uywyygzfd9mo5ggxq&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx522j&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx522j&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108742276/548867603/-793144256?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZWY0NmM0Yy00ZDNlLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_VZTQdKP_zhPi9kRoM7n5ryG2r9_TPOyRgEV1pNRBdM=&emci=21d512bf-f83b-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=5ef46c4c-4d3e-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=15759664)

When Virginia leads, the nation pays attention, Derek. This year, while most of the country is catching its breath after 2024, we’re sprinting toward the first major test of Democratic strength in the new Trump era: Virginia’s 2025 election. We’re fighting to protect abortion access, defend democracy from extremism, and make sure Virginia stays a beacon of progress in the South. And trust me: The GOP is watching. So is the media. And everyone else in the country. name: AOC
subject: Dystopia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
This is about the extreme concentration of money and power.
#
There is almost no area of our lives that has not been affected by this tech-billionaire class because they’re buying elections.
The balance of the Senate has been shifted because of the crypto lobby dumping millions of dollars into right-wing authoritarian candidates.
And it’s important to note that this money is not going into just issue-lobbying alone: this isn’t about crypto billionaires trying to buy favors for the crypto industry.
**This is about crypto billionaires trying to install and support authoritarians and fascists** , because they believe that if those fascists are personally close to them, then they can control far beyond the regulation of financial instruments.
They think they can really start imposing this dystopian worldview that includes everything from the subjugation of women to democracy itself. And we’re seeing this play out right now in the fight over Medicaid.
Beyond the Senate, Elon Musk dumped hundreds of millions of dollars into trying to buy the U.S. presidential election, and he is trying to recoup that investment by getting one of the largest tax cuts for billionaires in American history — which the Republican Party is trying to pay for through massive cuts to Medicaid, for Americans with disabilities, health care for the poor.
They’re trying to cut Medicaid and SNAP food assistance to pay for additional tax cuts for Elon Musk and his industries, as well. **This is about the extreme concentration of money and power.**
Trump’s billionaire, right-wing donors have taken hold.
Now, Republicans are making history with cuts to Medicaid and SNAP, and telling their constituents, “Well, we all are going to die.”1
Our movement for real progress will have to push harder than ever these next four years.
[Help us continue the fight against Trump and his right-wing extremism with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250531.A2nbfx&refcode=em20250531-8986-P_FND_CTR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8986%2E2526796%2Edw5v_6)

Alexandria

subject: An important reminder from Lizzie
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
The past few weeks have been challenging to say the least.
House Republicans passed their budget reconciliation bill that takes from the poor to give tax cuts to the rich. Nearly 14 million Americans are estimated to lose their health care coverage and millions of kids, seniors, and people with disabilities will be hungry because of the deep cuts to the social safety net we have established over the years to help those in need in America.
It’s a setback, but the fight isn’t over. There is a long way between today and seeing this bill on the President’s desk, and Lizzie will be fighting it every step of the way, weighing in as the Senate considers it and when a revised version comes back before the House. We can do more to stop these disastrous cuts and more.
What is happening now in the House just shows us why it is so important to take back the House in 2026 and make sure bills like this one aren’t even possible. That’s what we’re doing over here.
To help us reach this goal, we hope you will consider making a contribution before tonight’s end-of-month deadline so we can stay on track and do our work to take back the House. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250531?refcode=lpfe250531]
Thanks,
Team Lizzie

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Lizzie Fletcher
Date: May 30, 2025
Subject: It’s been a challenging month
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
Last week, late Wednesday night through the early hours of the morning Thursday, while most of the country was asleep, House Republicans passed their big ugly budget bill through the House of Representatives. With more than 1,000 pages and only a few hours to review them, House Republicans, with an assist from President Trump, worked through the dead of night to jam one of the most consequential and disastrous bills in memory through the House.
The bill is not fiscally responsible. It grows deficit spending and adds trillions to our national debt over the next 10 years. The bill is not morally defensible. It takes from the poor to give tax cuts to the rich.
House Democrats fought back, in committees—in mine, we pulled an all-nighter the week before in a 26 hour markup of some of this big budget bill’s provisions—in the Rules committee, and on the floor. In the end, the vote was 215-214-1. And now it is on to the Senate, which will make its own changes and send it back to the House.
So, we can’t give up. We will continue to fight the provisions in this bill that are so devastating—like kicking eligible Americans off Medicaid, eliminating tax credits that make health insurance more affordable, defunding Planned Parenthood, taking away food assistance and more. We will work in all the ways we can to make sure people know that this bill will hurt communities across the country, and we are trying to defeat it. The odds aren’t in our favor, but we won’t stop trying.
Last week, after the vote, I got a text from a dear friend with a photo and flashback from seven years ago. To the May night in 2018 that we won the Democratic primary runoff for TX-07. We did so through the collective efforts of a broad coalition of people that knew the stakes, did the work, and believed in the promise.
Six months later, in November 2018, Democrats won back the House majority—and we made history together as I became the first Democrat in more than 50 years and the first woman ever elected to represent our district in Congress. It wasn’t easy. It wasn’t guaranteed. In fact, many people told me it wasn’t possible to win. But we did.
Since then, we’ve faced historic challenges. But we’ve also shown what’s possible when we work together. Time and again, we’ve seen that making progress depends on all of us.
This month has provided so many more stark reminders of what’s at stake in our country right now. And why our work—your work—matters. If you’re in a position to make a contribution before the May end-of-month fundraising deadline tomorrow night, your support will help us not just to hold this seat, but to help take back the House in 2026. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250531?refcode=lpfe250531]
If this month has shown us anything, it’s that Democrats must take back the House. And if our TX07 races in 2018 and after show us anything, it’s that we can.
Together, we can do anything,
Lizzie Signature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]
