TLR, co-founded by Houston businessman Dick Weekley, is not a grassroots movement, but a front group for corporate interests. Weekley’s TLR PAC, funded by wealthy businessmen, including insurance companies and corporations, raised and spent over $20 million in the 2024 elections, supporting Republican candidates and legislators, so that they would introduce bills like Senate Bill 30 (SB30) and Senate Bill 39
(SB39) to protect corporate profits over legitimate injury claims of Texans. The Republicans, whom TLR supported that were elected, received over $12.5 million in donations. See below for a list of these Republicans. Is your State Representative or State Senator on the list of those who the TLR tried to buy off? Not all of them support TLR’s legislation, the TLR simply tries to buy their support. Most of these legislators support your constitutional rights, but they need to hear from you. Call them to encourage them to vote “No!” on TRL’s power play! TLR’s agenda prioritizes shielding negligent corporations, like reckless trucking firms or polluters, from having to compensate for injuries inflicted upon Texans. TLR should be renamed “Texans for Corporate Greed and Immunity,” because it consistently protects corporate interests by undermining the constitutional rights of those harmed by corporate misconduct. TLR’s spent millions in donations, over $20 million to Republican candidates in 2024 alone, to buy influence to advance their corporate agenda, not conservative values. By backing SB 30 and SB 39, TLR and Weekley undermine the constitutional rights of Texans to be compensated for injuries caused by negligent actions of individuals or businesses. Your State Representative needs to hear from you. Tell them to vote “No! on SB 30 and SB 39. You can click here to find your legislator at: https://wrm.capitol.texas.gov/home Call their office and tell them to vote “No!” on SB30 and SB39. SB 39 is still in the House Judiciary Committee. Call the offices of your Republican members and tell them to vote “No!” on both SB30 and SB39. SB30and on SB39 at (https://capitol.texas.gov (https://capitol.texas.gov/)). Why SB 30 and SB 39 Must Be Opposed 1\. Violation of the Texas Constitution
| 1. | Violation of the Texas Constitution
---|---
Both SB 30 and SB 39 undermine Article 1, Section 13 of the Texas Constitution, which guarantees that “All courts shall be open, and every person for an injury done him, in his lands, goods, person or reputation, shall have remedy by due course of law.”This constitutional provision ensures that you and other Texans have access to courts and meaningful compensation for injuries that have been inflicted upon you. SB 30caps health care expenses, denying full compensation for their injuries caused by corporate negligence, such as refinery workers maimed in explosions or families harmed in motor vehicle accidents. SB 39was written to “protect Texas trucking,” by restricting lawsuits against trucking companies, shielding corporations from liability for having negligently caused injuries to individuals. The Texas Supreme Court has struck down similar caps on compensation as unconstitutional (Lucas v. United States, 1988). These bills undermine our open courts provision in the Texas Constitution.
1\. SB 30 and SB 39 Harm Vulnerable Texans
1. | SB 30 and SB 39 Harm Vulnerable Texans
---|---
By capping medical expense recovery, SB 30 punishes uninsured Texans (over 4.3 million, including 623,000 children) and deters healthcare providers from treating them, leaving injured victims of corporate negligence with crushing bills. SB 39 limits lawsuits against trucking companies, even when their negligence causes catastrophic injuries or deaths on Texas roads. It protects corporate profits over families devastated by preventable crashes, undermining justice for those harmed by reckless corporate behavior.
Insurance Profits Soar, Yet No Relief for Texans
The Texas insurance industry, a key TLR backer, made an estimated $3.5 billion in profits in 2023 and $6.7 billion in 2024, an increase of over 90%, driven by premium hikes and investment gains. TLR admits that SB 30 will not lower insurance rates, nor will SB 39. These bills are not about helping you, the consumer. These bills shift the financial burden of corporate negligence onto victims, forcing families, healthcare providers, or taxpayers to cover costs, while insurers pocket record profits. SB 30 and SB 39 are about insulating corporations from liability for having caused negligent injuries, enabling them to make more profits at the expense of injured Texans.
1\. Trump’s Executive Order Requires that Truck Drivers Speak English; SB 39 Blocks Trump’s Order
1. | Trump’s Executive Order Requires that Truck Drivers Speak English; SB 39 Blocks Trump’s Order
---|---
President Trump signed an executive order making sure all commercial truck drivers speak English, but right now, Republican’s who support SB39 are opposing Trump's order for Texas.
SB 39 blocks admission of whether or not truck drivers speak English.
Texas Sheriffs oppose this bill because it makes Texas less safe.
You must act now to protect our constitutional rights and ensure justice for all Texans, not just corporate giants.
Call or email your state representative today, and tell him or her to oppose SB 30 and SB 39. Click on the following link to find your state representative: https://wrm.capitol.texas.gov/home
As conservatives, we must stand for our constitutional rights that guarantee liberty, justice, and the rule of law. Let’s defeat SB 30 and SB 39 to protect Texans from TLR’s profit-driven assault on our Texas Constitution.
Editorial by Steven Hotze, M.D.,

I want to reach out with a hopeful message today.

Yes, this moment is terrifying. Donald Trump and his Republican loyalists are doing everything they can to gut vital government programs, pad the wallets of the wealthiest Americans and turn all of us against each other.

But I truly remain hopeful that together, we can turn the page on this tough moment in our history and be the ones who proudly stood together for everything we believe in.

I’m hopeful because every single day, my team and I hear from teachers, nurses, union workers, seniors, parents and hardworking Americans who still believe that change is possible.

**They know it won’t come easy. And a lot of them spend their days thinking about how they’re going to pay that next bill, access the health care they need or put food on the table for their families.**

The reality is: Most people are not paying close attention to the constant stream of bad news coming out of Washington, D.C — or they’re just plain tired of hearing it. I can’t say I blame them.

But they do know we need change. It’s our responsibility to keep fighting for an America that represents all of us.

I’m asking you to stick with me in this fight. | | When I first heard that a book I wrote was one of hundreds banned from the U.S. Naval Academy library under the Trump regime, I found the news incredibly concerning. You see, my book — _Our Time Is Now_ — chronicles the erosion of voting rights, highlights the far right’s attacks on democracy, and provides a blueprint for ending voter suppression and empowering our fellow citizens to uphold and expand free and fair elections. And if the far right actually believes that my book about ensuring democracy is a threat to their ability to destroy it, then I’m on to something. In addition, I’m proud to be in the company of authors like Dr. Carol Anderson, a renowned historian and professor of African American studies who serves on the Board of Directors for Fair Fight Action. Her book _White Rage: The Unspoken Truth Of Our Racial Divide_ was also banned. It won the National Book Critics Circle Award for criticism, and it analyzes the struggle for Black Americans to be full participants in our democracy. Of course, the ultimate target of book bans like these is the power that we, the people, possess. The power that MAGA Republicans would suppress. The power that we must use. **With our freedoms facing grave threats, and with people in power trying to keep us from understanding how to defend it, we must double down in our fight for democracy.** **And we must support groups like Fair Fight that do the vital work of making our democracy live up to its promise, tackling the rise of authoritarianism, and ensuring free and fair elections.** [**That’s why I need to ask if you can make a donation of any amount to Fair Fight. Let’s be clear: You ban books if you’re afraid of the knowledge they can provide and the questions they may inspire readers to ask.
And you suppress the vote if you’re afraid you could not win a truly fair election — or if you believe some people are inherently unworthy of participating in our democracy.
My book was banned alongside works of literature and scholarship by people like Maya Angelou and Ibram X. Kendi.
Mind you, they did not ban _Mein Kampf_ , by Adolf Hitler.
The targeted books are about topics like race, gender, and public policy, and they fall under MAGA’s attack on DEI — also known as “diversity, equity, and inclusion”; also known as the basis for all the movements of progress and opportunity we’ve achieved as a nation.
**Moves like these reveal the Trump regime’s outright contempt for civil rights and the ability of women, people of color, and marginalized communities to be part of American life. And as they continue working to suppress our voices, we must keep on fighting back.**
**I’m proud that Fair Fight stands strong against attacks on our democracy.**
I founded Fair Fight after the 2018 elections to help make sure every eligible voter can easily register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted. Since its founding, Fair Fight has successfully combated voter suppression, made it possible for more people to exercise their power and their voice at the ballot box, and helped elect pro-democracy champions from municipal governments to the U.S. Senate and the presidency.
Fair Fight will continue building pro-voter political power in the South, expanding access to voting, preventing mass voter purges, and pioneering strategic analysis and innovation to counter rising authoritarianism.
But none of this work is possible without dedicated supporters like you.

clean_body: I need to ask if you can make a donation to fight for our freedoms and democracy. | | | When I first heard that a book I wrote was one of hundreds banned from the U.S. Naval Academy library under the Trump regime, I found the news incredibly concerning. You see, my book — Our Time Is Now — chronicles the erosion of voting rights, highlights the far right’s attacks on democracy, and provides a blueprint for ending voter suppression and empowering our fellow citizens to uphold and expand free and fair elections. And if the far right actually believes that my book about ensuring democracy is a threat to their ability to destroy it, then I’m on to something. In addition, I’m proud to be in the company of authors like Dr. Carol Anderson, a renowned historian and professor of African American studies who serves on the Board of Directors for Fair Fight Action. Her book White Rage: The Unspoken Truth Of Our Racial Divide was also banned. It won the National Book Critics Circle Award for criticism, and it analyzes the struggle for Black Americans to be full participants in our democracy. Of course, the ultimate target of book bans like these is the power that we, the people, possess. The power that MAGA Republicans would suppress. The power that we must use. With our freedoms facing grave threats, and with people in power trying to keep us from understanding how to defend it, we must double down in our fight for democracy. And we must support groups like Fair Fight that do the vital work of making our democracy live up to its promise, tackling the rise of authoritarianism, and ensuring free and fair elections. = | = Let’s be clear: You ban books if you’re afraid of the knowledge they can provide and the questions they may inspire readers to ask. And you suppress the vote if you’re afraid you could not win a truly fair election — or if you believe some people are inherently unworthy of participating in our democracy. My book was banned alongside works of literature and scholarship by people like Maya Angelou and Ibram X. Kendi. Mind you, they did not ban Mein Kampf , by Adolf Hitler. The targeted books are about topics like race, gender, and public policy, and they fall under MAGA’s attack on DEI — also known as “diversity, equity, and inclusion”; also known as the basis for all the movements of progress and opportunity we’ve achieved as a nation. Moves like these reveal the Trump regime’s outright contempt for civil rights and the ability of women, people of color, and marginalized communities to be part of American life. And as they continue working to suppress our voices, we must keep on fighting back. I’m proud that Fair Fight stands strong against attacks on our democracy. I founded Fair Fight after the 2018 elections to help make sure every eligible voter can easily register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted. Since its founding, Fair Fight has successfully combated voter suppression, made it possible for more people to exercise their power and their voice at the ballot box, and helped elect pro-democracy champions from municipal governments to the U.S. Senate and the presidency. Fair Fight will continue building pro-voter political power in the South, expanding access to voting, preventing mass voter purges, and pioneering strategic analysis and innovation to counter rising authoritarianism. We’ve been talking a lot the last few days about the momentum here at IDCCA, but I also want to talk about something not so positive: Trump’s new big ugly tax and spending bill that passed the House.

subject: The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers
body:
Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood corruption| | |
---
| | Dear Patriot, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... **by David Shuster**
It's not every day that a former Trump White House lawyer goes on TV and mercilessly mocks Trump and his dolt-on-a-wire Press Secretary, Karoline Leavitt. But _that_ happened this week. In one appearance on CNN, Ty Cobb, the lawyer with the hall of fame name, smacked Leavitt as "Creepy Karoline" and blasted Trump as a "ranting wounded narcissist."
The beatdowns came in the aftermath of a federal court ruling in Manhattan that blocked most of the Trump tariffs. In a 3-0 unanimous decision, the U.S. federal court of International Trade in Manhattan said Trump had exceeded his authority under the International Economic Powers Act.
Congress, which typically has the tariff power, passed the act nearly 50 years ago. It gives a President the authority to bypass lawmakers on tariffs in a _national emergency_ , specifically war. The court rejected Trump's claim that trade deficits trigger the act. The court noted that no U.S. President until Trump ever invoked the act. And every President for the past 48 years has presided over trade deficits.
Naturally, Trump and his team went ballistic when informed that a court was stomping on their tariff bypass of Congress as well as their delicate egos. Trump press secretary Karoline Leavitt furiously took to the briefing room to declare, "America cannot function if President Trump, or any other President for that matter, has their sensitive diplomatic or trade negotiations railroaded by activist judges."
Leavitt added, "these judges are threatening to undermine the credibility of the United States on the world stage." Yes, despite Trump's on-again, off-again, on-again policy on tariffs, often with random countries he doesn't even know why he's attacking, it's a court that is undermining U.S. credibility. Remarkable.
Thankfully, Ty Cobb stepped up to the punditry plate on CNN and just completely crushed it. Quote: "I don't think creepy Karoline, when she speaks, I don't think anybody in America takes her seriously on a matter of substance. She is not learned by any imagination."
Cobb noted that one of the three judges on the Court of International Trade is Tim Reif. Trump appointed Reif to the court. And Reif, a conservative, is considered one of the most highly regarded experts on trade law in the United States. Translation: The Supreme Court is highly unlikely to overturn the ruling.
Trump himself is making the odds even longer thanks to one of his latest unhinged Truth Social Media posts. An irate and petulant Trump blamed the string of adverse court rulings on a conservative activist named Leonard Leo. Leo used to run the Federalist Society, which recommended judges to Trump during his first term and fought for their appointments. Now, Trump hates the man.
Trump wrote that Leo is a "sleazebag... a bad person who, in his own way, probably hates America." Many on the liberal side of the spectrum probably agree with Trump on this singular point.
The funny thing about Leo, though, is that he is reportedly close friends with Supreme Court Justices Amy Coney Barrett, Neil Gorsuch, and Brett Cavanaugh - yes, if you're counting, the very three justices appointed by Trump. So, Trump's not exactly helping himself or his tariff case with those particular members of the The Court. And based on the case alone, Trump's climb was steep to begin with.

In other words, a Trump humiliation at SCOTUS is most on the menu pretty soon. And that's on top of the endless ridicule he is facing already on social media, and even in some corporate media outlets, over the term T.A.C.O.
The story here's as funny as it is sad for America: Wall Street traders, pointing to their gains in betting against Trump's initial policy pronouncements--in particular, tariff threats--have coined the acronym to mean Trump Always Chickens Out. The internet is going wild and making it stick. My favorite is a video of Wall street traders with chicken heads dancing around the NYSE. The music bed is the infamous "chicken dance polka."
* _**Watch, for the sheer hilarity**_

[](https://substack.com/redirect/16c248a5-b8dc-48b2-a53c-b69ae5df305e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Yes, the internet always wins. And Trump's losses in court, on TV, and across social media are getting more epic by the day. Enjoy it all thoroughly. Through the years, Trump famously (and sometimes amusingly) belittled his rivals with nicknames including "Little Marco," "Low Energy Jeb," and "Crooked Hillary."
My bet is that all of it was Trumpian projection. But that's a subject for a different day. Now, Chicken Trump and his chief propaganda minister, Creepy Karoline, are getting what they deserve.
As the saying goes, "the chickens are coming home to roost."

Peter, it’s Ritchie.

Growing up in public housing in the Bronx, there weren’t a lot of people like me in Washington. It wasn’t easy, but it shaped my journey as a public servant.

**Knowing what it’s like to be _left behind_ by political leaders who pledged to serve me, I ran for Congress in 2020 to deliver real and meaningful change to the hardworking people of the Bronx — _the people who raised me._**

➔ Peter, that’s why you can _always_ count on me to fight for affordable housing and working families.

➔ You can _always_ count on me to fight for social safety nets like Social Security, Medicaid, Medicare, and SNAP.

➔ You can _always_ count on me to ensure marginalized voices have a seat at the table —to fight for LGBTQ+ rights, to combat hate, to protect reproductive freedom, and to expand voting rights.

I may not have the fanciest resume in Congress, but what I lack in credentials, I make up for in lived experience — and it’s my lived experience that shapes my fight in New York and Washington everyday.

body:
What’s happening and how we’re fighting back >>
|

Peter, it could soon get harder to vote in Ohio — and that’s just the beginning.
If you’ve been following the SAVE Act in Congress, two matching state-level bills are basically Ohio’s version, but even worse, because they also attack the citizen petition process for new ballot measures.
**We continue to see how far politicians will go to try to silence voters’ voices.** In Ohio, we’re mobilizing volunteers to contact their lawmakers and demand that they reject these attacks on democracy. And throughout America, we’ll keep fighting new and ongoing attempts at taking power away from the people.

In Ohio, SB 153 and HB 233 would change over 40 sections of law governing voting and elections.
They would create three entirely new sections of voting law and add new SAVE Act-style requirements that would **make it harder for Ohioans — especially seniors, low-income individuals, students, and rural voters — to exercise the fundamental right to vote. **
In addition, the legislation would jeopardize the citizen petition process**** for ballot measures by **threatening petition committee members and circulators with politically motivated investigations** — which could criminalize civic-minded community members for being engaged in democracy.
These proposals are massive, unnecessary, and deeply harmful — and they must be stopped at all costs.

clean_body: What’s happening and how we’re fighting back >> | Peter, it could soon get harder to vote in Ohio — and that’s just the beginning. If you’ve been following the SAVE Act in Congress, two matching state-level bills are basically Ohio’s version, but even worse, because they also attack the citizen petition process for new ballot measures. We continue to see how far politicians will go to try to silence voters’ voices. In Ohio, we’re mobilizing volunteers to contact their lawmakers and demand that they reject these attacks on democracy. And throughout America, we’ll keep fighting new and ongoing attempts at taking power away from the people. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = In Ohio, SB 153 and HB 233 would change over 40 sections of law governing voting and elections. They would create three entirely new sections of voting law and add new SAVE Act-style requirements that would make it harder for Ohioans — especially seniors, low-income individuals, students, and rural voters — to exercise the fundamental right to vote. In addition, the legislation would jeopardize the citizen petition process** for ballot measures by threatening petition committee members and circulators with politically motivated investigations — which could criminalize civic-minded community members for being engaged in democracy. These proposals are massive, unnecessary, and deeply harmful — and they must be stopped at all costs. = We’ll have more updates from Ohio in the weeks ahead. Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. clean_body: Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail | | | Trump’s order is the culmination of years of attacks on absentee ballots and vote-by-mail. In the months before the 2020 election, Trump repeatedly spread disinformation and conspiracy theories about the legitimacy of mail-in ballots as he campaigned for reelection. Now that he's back in power he wants to end their use forever. | | | | | We're going to keep hammering this home, Team,** because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever. President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail. For background:** After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day. So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day. This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast. If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections. Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail. Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic. Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ” | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. Hi Derek — I wanted to reach out to you one last time before tonight’s fundraising deadline to ask if you could pitch in to our campaign.
I’ve always believed that people should be held accountable for their actions — even if they’re the President of the United States.
That’s why, from my time as lead impeachment manager to my work as a U.S. Senator, I’ve made it a point to fight Donald Trump’s corruption and hold his administration accountable.
He doesn’t like that very much, and neither do his MAGA allies or Fox News. They’ve launched threats and insults against me for years, and who knows what else may come my way.
But even in the face of their attacks, it’s people like you who strengthen my resolve to keep up this work. Your support for me shows the MAGA movement that I’m not alone in this fight. **There are people in California and all across the country who are willing to stand with me and fight for truth, decency, and our Constitution.**
We’re facing a big fundraising deadline tonight, and I would really appreciate your help. **If you can, please use this link to pitch in and fuel my work to fight back against Trump’s lawlessness:**[secure.actblue.com/donate/q22025_abs_em?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22025_abs_em.gs9A_9&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20250531_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=8640%2E5257348%2EYULtDK)**
Thank you so much,

If you need a bit more of an explanation, let me take a moment to tell you why this matters so much to me.
When I think about what we’ve achieved in Michigan, I’m proud. Proud of the progress we’ve made. Proud of the way we’ve governed. And proud of the people-powered movement that made it all possible.
Because here’s the truth: **While some across the country have been focused on rolling back reproductive rights, restricting how we teach history, or silencing the voices of working people — we’ve been doing the opposite. **
In Michigan, we’ve enshrined reproductive freedom into our state constitution. We’ve protected LGBTQ+ rights. We’ve expanded access to the ballot box and made historic investments in public education. We’ve made sure that when national politics get chaotic, Michiganders still have a firewall of leadership that puts people first.
**That didn’t happen by accident. It happened because people stepped up to run, to organize, to lead — and because people just like you supported them. **
But progress isn’t permanent. If we want to keep moving forward, we need to keep building. We need to invest in the next generation of leaders who are ready to fight for working families, protect our rights, and make government work for the people.
That takes hard work, early investment, and belief. Belief in people who haven’t run before but should. People who are fired up, who live their values, and who need someone to say, _“You’d be great. You should run.”_
That’s what Fight Like Hell PAC is doing, and your support makes it all possible.

#

That deadline comes at a moment unlike any other in our nation’s history.
I served in Iraq as a Marine at the height of the war, about 20 years ago. All those years ago, I never thought I’d see the President of the United States blatantly ignore the Supreme Court. I signed up to defend our Constitution. To make sure exactly that kind of thing never happened at home.
This is authoritarianism. It is here. And we need to stand up now or risk losing the rights and liberties we were born with.
You know what’s happening, but most people still don’t. If we’re going to build a movement that stops and reverses Trump’s power grab, we have to start reaching the people who aren’t reading the news every day.

subject: Fani Willis is trying to lock my husband away for the rest of his life
body:
Help save my husband and my family| | |
---
Dear Patriot,If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason.She's the radical District Attorney in Georgia who's been abusing her office to target innocent police officers.And now, **starting this Monday** , she’s trying to lock my husband away for the rest of his life for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe.**[Before I ask for your urgent help, let me start at the beginning...](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9ee8b1e87c304ea2b10e6945128911ec&_e=-QyHjITHXhBUE6AJPKkjTR3arI25bDgxwOyWCKfwnnmgvnwmViQgDOYnlVe3ryOlqbqdvIGQVa6DVtB5VyfHKKrnLqcTDuAFWjSX0LrGaBWGg1lA3rhTV-UvP1JiRQs4_urXJf0Ro4rcukyggWtkcZjlEQAg3MKv82MCktZagO9cEolBXyxXWqcir2V048ujpva_Ntzbb2cS0Sg8XSTNKCkW_f_39ntXJKdeEKbSBvJpMNzhBh61VykGEmaI9KhnMQPVYjmueDkbGPDPQD41SLha8pPMzNv9YNQ2vxFRKaTTyTHWVgkITaC3bC04PTDV9yuyo_uXoCWXOfmsKCR2Acn0u2XW_xMBwcmKw2ICwapstMemEWIx21CoWysJnv0F-Rale6DW5iiyvKza9SJSqw%3D%3D) **My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. That's me, James, and our son in the photo I sent.
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9ee8b1e87c304ea2b10e6945128911ec&_e=-QyHjITHXhBUE6AJPKkjTR3arI25bDgxwOyWCKfwnnmgvnwmViQgDOYnlVe3ryOlqbqdvIGQVa6DVtB5VyfHKKrnLqcTDuAFWjSX0LrGaBWGg1lA3rhTV-UvP1JiRQs4_urXJf0Ro4rcukyggWtkcZjlEQAg3MKv82MCktZagO9cEolBXyxXWqcir2V048ujpva_Ntzbb2cS0Sg8XSTNKCkW_f_39ntXJKdeEKbSBvKK11QXqWNxO6Gb2a1zNTcICVPJkPxDMXzJsNIR8Znxd9DsU2VgG7UhseUU__aZWdv4V4xXYk2E5PoX0edVMF98qEBpO7Zu0q2TrIHe_pSmqZo4_igRytWdZZGgQnbJ-PkdXJrnluFRh77cyK5HGwghSfpXmt99paSs3ZpkXpi1Qg%3D%3D)
---
Being a police officer meant the world to James. He was born and raised in Atlanta, and saw his job as a way to help his neighbors. But if Fani Willis has her way... **life in prison** could be his reward.Our nightmare started nine years ago, when my husband responded to a call about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate.That's when it happened. The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him.With only a split second to act, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly. James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!** You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. So the woke, anti-police prosecutors in Atlanta have made it their mission to destroy my husband. Now you understand why I'm so upset and why [**I'm turning to you for help.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9ee8b1e87c304ea2b10e6945128911ec&_e=-QyHjITHXhBUE6AJPKkjTR3arI25bDgxwOyWCKfwnnmgvnwmViQgDOYnlVe3ryOlqbqdvIGQVa6DVtB5VyfHKKrnLqcTDuAFWjSX0LrGaBWGg1lA3rhTV-UvP1JiRQs4_urXJf0Ro4rcukyggWtkcZjlEQAg3MKv82MCktZagO9cEolBXyxXWqcir2V048ujpva_Ntzbb2cS0Sg8XSTNKCkW_f_39ntXJKdeEKbSBvLz2Pu6FJ-9PQp9Vuvc0_xxijoDIZrvgTX4g0QLsFlv3sQXFTW95NKga4DzfEk6vwYPGeSm1KdtfFOM6RfXnp5UTMn9CTcisvlExMddT6UKXTSVUOruO7AZya63fm0IoPbheT6-T4_9VksCgv203JeHtYxJIKwkkGGvZIyQ0SvNCw%3D%3D) James is an honest, hardworking, good-hearted man who only wants to help people.My husband is exactly the kind of man you want keeping your city safe.But none of that matters to radical prosecutors like Fani Willis. She knows what happened that night. She knows James was in a life-or-death situation. She knows that the charge should have been dropped years ago.Fani Willis just wants to make an example out of my husband - starting this Monday. Friend, for years we've been trapped in limbo. We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband.By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. As you can imagine after 9 years of prosecution, what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense. When we ran out of money, we had all but given up hope... **And then we got a call from Jason Johnson, the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF.** If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongfully-accused police officers like James. Not only did the LELDF board decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys so James can finally clear his name.Friend, that's why I'm writing to you today to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone... # _**Your YDA May Newsletter**_
---
_**A Message from Young Democrats of America President Quentin Wathum-Ocama**_
---
Dear Young Democrats and Supporters -- We find ourselves confronting a presidency that has rapidly dismantled democratic norms, undermined civil liberties, and prioritized authoritarian power over the public good. Donald Trump's return to the White House has been marked by a barrage of executive actions and policies that threaten the very fabric of our democracy. In just a few months, Trump has:
* Illegally imposed sweeping tariffs under the guise of national emergency, a move recently struck down by a federal court for exceeding presidential authority.
* Revived "Schedule F", making it easier to purge federal employees and replace them with loyalists, effectively politicizing the civil service.
* Targeted marginalized communities, including rolling back protections for LGBTQ+ individuals, limiting access to abortion and gender-affirming care, and pushing state-level laws designed to intimidate voters and criminalize protest.
* Issued controversial pardons, including for January 6 rioters convicted of assaulting police officers and attempting to overturn the results of a free and fair election.
* Undermined foreign policy, taking an increasingly erratic and isolationist approach that alienates our allies, weakens support for countries like Ukraine, and emboldens authoritarian regimes.

These actions are not isolated--they are part of a coordinated effort outlined in Project 2025, a right-wing blueprint to dismantle our institutions, concentrate power in the executive branch, and roll back decades of progress on civil rights, environmental protections, and public education.

And yet--young people continue to rise.

We are organizing for justice, mobilizing our communities, and standing up for a future rooted in dignity, freedom, and fairness. Whether in the streets, at the ballot box, or in our neighborhoods, we are proving that this generation will not back down.

The work ahead will continue to be hard, but it is necessary. We must stay informed, build power at the local level, support one another, and fight like hell for the future we believe in.

Together, we are the firewall. Together, we are the future.

**In solidarity and hope,**

# **_Young Democrats Appointed to Key DNC Roles and Committees_**
---
Young Democrats are continuing to make history at the national level. DNC Chair Ken Martin recently appointed several members of the Young Democrats of America and the DNC Youth Council to influential roles across the Democratic National Committee.

**Stephanie Campanha Wheaton** was appointed to the Rules & Bylaws Committee--believed to be the first person under 35 to serve on the RBC in at least a decade. **Nathaniel Robert** received an At-Large DNC seat, while **Coby Owens** and **Matt Hughes** were appointed to the Credentials Committee. Jason Par**k,** **Cory Lemke** , and Oregon Chair **Nathan Soltz** will serve on the Resolutions Committee.

These appointments reflect a growing commitment to uplifting young voices and ensuring the future of the Party is shaped by those who will carry it forward.

clean_body: In May here’s what need to know >>> | | Your YDA May Newsletter A Message from Young Democrats of America President Quentin Wathum-Ocama Dear Young Democrats and Supporters -- We find ourselves confronting a presidency that has rapidly dismantled democratic norms, undermined civil liberties, and prioritized authoritarian power over the public good. Donald Trump's return to the White House has been marked by a barrage of executive actions and policies that threaten the very fabric of our democracy. In just a few months, Trump has: Illegally imposed sweeping tariffs under the guise of national emergency, a move recently struck down by a federal court for exceeding presidential authority. Revived "Schedule F", making it easier to purge federal employees and replace them with loyalists, effectively politicizing the civil service. Targeted marginalized communities, including rolling back protections for LGBTQ+ individuals, limiting access to abortion and gender-affirming care, and pushing state-level laws designed to intimidate voters and criminalize protest. Issued controversial pardons, including for January 6 rioters convicted of assaulting police officers and attempting to overturn the results of a free and fair election. Undermined foreign policy, taking an increasingly erratic and isolationist approach that alienates our allies, weakens support for countries like Ukraine, and emboldens authoritarian regimes. These actions are not isolated--they are part of a coordinated effort outlined in Project 2025, a right-wing blueprint to dismantle our institutions, concentrate power in the executive branch, and roll back decades of progress on civil rights, environmental protections, and public education. And yet--young people continue to rise. We are organizing for justice, mobilizing our communities, and standing up for a future rooted in dignity, freedom, and fairness. Whether in the streets, at the ballot box, or in our neighborhoods, we are proving that this generation will not back down. The work ahead will continue to be hard, but it is necessary. We must stay informed, build power at the local level, support one another, and fight like hell for the future we believe in. Together, we are the firewall. Together, we are the future. clean_body: Let's show our candidates that while they're out delivering for their communities, we're right here delivering the support they need to keep going strong. | = Hi Peter, At EMILYs List, we know the fight doesn't stop when the polls close — this work is year-round. Our candidates don't wait for election season to lead. They're showing up every day to protect abortion access, fight for families, and defend our rights, even when nobody's watching. That's why we've set a critical goal: $150,000 by midnight tonight to keep fueling this movement. Our candidates stand up for us. Now it's time for us to show up for them. **= | = While Republicans push dangerous legislation to appease their donors and extreme base, EMILYs List women are on the frontlines fighting for their communities: Rep. Mikie Sherrill (NJ-GOV) and Rep. Emilia Sykes (OH-13) reintroduced the Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act to reaffirm access to emergency abortion care, after the Department of Justice dropped a case that sought to protect it. Sec. of State Jocelyn Benson (MI-GOV) is protecting elections and the personal data of Michigan voters while Michigan House Republicans play political games and undermine the security of future elections. State Sen. Ghazala Hashmi (VA-LG) is protecting reproductive care in Virginia — leading bold legislation to shield health care workers from extremist attacks. This is what leadership looks like. These women don't just make promises, they deliver progress. And it's on us to have their backs. Peter,

**I won’t sugar coat it:** the last few weeks in Washington have been tough. When I worry about the future of our country, or when things look particularly bleak, I try to find solace in faith and prayer. As I prepare for church tomorrow, I find myself reflecting on a particular passage of scripture from Matthew: | _‘For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in, I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.’

Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink? When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you? When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?’

The King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.’_
---
**Peter, my life is in service of the “least of these.”** And I will not stop fighting for them.
